A disgruntled science teacher had recently been fired from her job at the local high school. She told a parent, who was the communications chairperson for the high school's parent-teacher organization, that the principal was having an affair with the married assistant principal. The parent immediately sent a group email to all of the parents at the high school that included the following statement: "I'm not sure if this is true or not, but the science teacher said that the principal is having an affair with the assistant principal!"
The principal, who was not having an affair with the assistant principal, subsequently sued the parent for libel.
Is the principal likely to prevail?

A popular sports magazine published an investigative article detailing the prohibited tactics used by a university football program to recruit and retain top players. The article stated that at least five players had received postgame cash from their coaches based on performance during the game. One of those players, the quarterback, was quoted as saying that he lived "rent-free at the ranch of a booster club member" who had told him, "I'll pay you $400 a week to shoe horses and shovel manure." The quarterback was further quoted as saying, "I never even touched a horse [at the ranch]."
Soon after the article was published, the booster club member was asked to leave the club because of the public outrage created by the article. The booster club member now seeks to file an action against the magazine, alleging that the quarterback did odd jobs to earn his keep and that the magazine had published the article with reckless disregard for its truthfulness.
Under which theory would the booster club member be most likely to recover?

A board-certified vascular surgeon applied for privileges at a newly built hospital to expand his practice. The chief of vascular surgery at the hospital decided to sabotage the surgeon's application in order to maintain exclusive control over the vascular surgery department. The chief told the hospital's board members, who were responsible for reviewing the surgeon's application, that she had received disturbing data about his practice's unusually high patient-mortality rates. She then presented the board with data that she had fabricated. The board was disturbed by the fabricated data and therefore decided to reject the surgeon's application.
As a result of the board's decision to reject his application, the surgeon is unable to perform surgeries at the newly built hospital. The surgeon claims that his practice has suffered pecuniary losses in the form of lost revenue. He has sought the advice of his attorney regarding which action against the chief of vascular surgery is most likely to succeed.
What sort of action against the chief of vascular surgery should the attorney recommend?

A man lived in a lakefront home. The man suspected that his neighbor was emptying her septic tank into the lake. Although he did not have any tangible proof, the man had seen the neighbor putting a large hose that led from an area in the neighbor's backyard where the septic tank was located into the lake late at night. Based upon this observation, the man identified the neighbor by name and made the following statement to a local reporter: "She is polluting the lake and ruining its ecosystem by dumping the contents of her septic tank into it every night!"
The reporter published the statement in the newspaper. Upon reading it, the neighbor was horrified because in actuality she had simply been pumping water from the lake into her backyard.
If the neighbor brings a defamation action against the man, will the neighbor be likely to prevail?

A female quarterback was the only female on an otherwise all-male college football team. During training one day, one of the team's offensive linemen saw the female quarterback hidden behind the bleachers, injecting herself with a needle. The lineman immediately told the football team's coach that he had just seen the female quarterback injecting herself with steroids. The female quarterback was diabetic and had actually been injecting insulin into her arm when the lineman saw her behind the bleachers. However, not knowing this, the coach suspended the female quarterback from the team.
If the female quarterback files a defamation suit against the lineman, who is likely to prevail?

A statistics professor told a friend that one of the professor's graduate students had failed an introductory statistics course in the second quarter of his sophomore year in college. The friend repeated this statement to an economics professor, but the friend prefaced it with the proviso that she had heard the information from the statistics professor and had no personal knowledge of whether it was true.
The student later learned of the statement and initiated a lawsuit against the friend for slander. At trial, the friend offered evidence of the student's college transcript from sophomore year. However, the transcript proved that the student had failed the introductory statistics course in the first quarter, not the second quarter, of his sophomore year in college.
Can the student likely recover?

A man lives in a small community where there is only one judge. The man recently lost a highly publicized court case that had been adjudicated by her, and he was convinced that she had issued an unfair judgment. As the man left the courthouse, he made this statement to a reporter: "Judges are crooks, and they will accept bribes if you pay them enough!" The statement was subsequently printed in the local newspaper.
The judge had never accepted a bribe, and after reading the statement in the newspaper, she filed a defamation action against the man.
Will the judge be likely to prevail?

questions.question:
A venture capitalist read through a publicly held corporation's most recent financial statement, which was available on the corporation's website. The corporation's financial statement disclosed that the book value of the corporation's stock was $10 per share, but its actual value is $50 per share. The venture capitalist also noticed that the corporation had invested heavily to develop a new social media platform over the previous year. After doing more research, she became convinced that this platform would become extremely popular and would, in turn, drive up the price of the corporation's stock.
The venture capitalist approached one of the corporation's shareholders whom she had never met. She offered to buy his 500 shares at $15 a share. The shareholder said that he thought that the shares were worth more. The venture capitalist did not respond. Eventually, the shareholder agreed to the venture capitalist's price for the 500 shares. Two months after this sale, the shareholder learned about the actual value of the stock and the corporation's investment in the new social media platform.
The shareholder asserted a misrepresentation claim against the venture capitalist.
Will the shareholder likely prevail on his claim?

choices.a: No, because the shareholder had access to the corporation's most recent financial statement at the time of the sale.
choices.b: No, because the venture capitalist had no duty to disclose the shares' actual value.
choices.c: Yes, because the venture capitalist had a duty to disclose the shares' actual value when she made the offer.
choices.d: Yes, because the venture capitalist had a duty to disclose the shares' actual value when the shareholder commented about their actual worth.

一名风险资本家阅读了一家上市公司在其网站上公布的最新财务报表。该公司的财务报表披露，其股票的账面价值为每股10美元，但其实际价值为每股50美元。该风险资本家还注意到，该公司在过去一年中投入巨资开发一个新的社交媒体平台。经过更多研究，她确信该平台将变得非常受欢迎，并进而推高公司的股价。

该风险资本家接触了一位她从未见过的公司股东。她要约以每股15美元的价格购买他的500股股票。该股东表示，他认为这些股票的价值不止于此。风险资本家没有回应。最终，该股东同意了风险资本家提出的500股股票的价格。此次出售两个月后，该股东了解到了股票的实际价值以及公司对新社交媒体平台的投资。

该股东对风险资本家提起了虚假陈述之诉。

该股东的诉讼请求可能得到支持吗？
options:
A. No, because the shareholder had access to the corporation's most recent financial statement at the time of the sale.
否，因为在出售时，该股东可以查阅该公司的最新财务报表。

B. No, because the venture capitalist had no duty to disclose the shares' actual value.
否，因为该风险资本家没有义务披露股票的实际价值。

C. Yes, because the venture capitalist had a duty to disclose the shares' actual value when she made the offer.
是，因为当该风险资本家发出要约时，她有义务披露股票的实际价值。

D. Yes, because the venture capitalist had a duty to disclose the shares' actual value when the shareholder commented about their actual worth.
是，因为当股东评论其股票的实际价值时，风险资本家有义务披露该股票的实际价值。
data.explanation:
Liability for misrepresentation generally arises when a defendant actively misrepresents a material fact. However, nondisclosure of a material fact will also subject a defendant to liability if the defendant had a duty to disclose it. This duty arises when the defendant is engaged in a business transaction with a plaintiff who is:
  • in a fiduciary relationship with the defendant
  • likely to be misled by the defendant's prior statements or
  • mistaken about a basic fact of the transaction that the defendant is aware of and can reasonably be expected to disclose.
Here, the venture capitalist knew that her offer to buy the shareholder's shares of the corporation's stock was less than their actual value (material fact) but did not disclose that information to the shareholder. However, she had no duty to disclose it because:
  • the parties had just met (no fiduciary relationship)
  • she only offered to purchase his shares and made no misleading statement before or after his comment about their actual worth (Choice D) and
  • she could not reasonably be expected to reveal that her offer was low because people routinely try to buy stocks for as little as possible to increase the value of the purchase in the long run (Choice C).
Therefore, the shareholder likely will not prevail on his misrepresentation claim.

(Choice A) The fact that the shareholder had access to the corporation's financial statement would not have defeated his misrepresentation claim had the venture capitalist owed him a duty to disclose that information - eg, had the venture capitalist been his financial advisor (fiduciary relationship).

Educational objective: A defendant must disclose material facts during a business transaction with a plaintiff who is (1) in a fiduciary relationship with the defendant, (2) likely to be misled by the defendant's prior statements, or (3) mistaken about a basic fact of the transaction that the defendant is aware of and can reasonably be expected to disclose.



选项正确率统计：A选项 26%，B选项 60%（正确选项），C选项 4%，D选项 8%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

因虚假陈述（misrepresentation）而产生的责任，通常在被告主动对重要事实作出虚假陈述时出现。然而，如果被告有披露义务，其未披露重要事实的行为也会使其承担责任。当被告与原告进行商业交易，且原告符合以下情况时，此义务即产生：
  • 与被告处于信托关系中
  • 可能被被告先前的陈述误导 或
  • 对交易的一项基本事实存在误解，且被告意识到此误解并被合理期待予以披露。
在本案中，该风险资本家知道她购买该股东公司股票的要约价格低于其实际价值（重要事实），但并未向股东披露该信息。然而，她没有义务披露该信息，因为：
  • 双方刚刚认识（不存在信托关系）
  • 她仅要约购买其股票，并且在该股东评论其股票实际价值之前或之后，均未做出误导性陈述（选项D） 并且
  • 不能合理期待她会透露其要约价格过低，因为人们通常会试图以尽可能低的价格购买股票，以增加购买的长期价值（选项C）。
因此，该股东的虚假陈述之诉很可能不会得到支持。

（选项A） 即使股东可以查阅公司的财务报表，如果风险资本家对他负有披露该信息的义务——例如，如果风险资本家是他的财务顾问（信托关系）——这一事实也不能推翻他的虚假陈述之诉。

教学目标： 在商业交易中，如果原告符合以下情况之一，被告必须披露重要事实：（1）与被告处于信托关系中，（2）可能被被告先前的陈述误导，或（3）对交易的一项基本事实存在误解，且被告意识到此误解并被合理期待予以披露。

References

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 551 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (liability for nondisclosure).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考题解析

Torts: Misrepresentation (侵权法：虚假陈述)
✅ 正确答案：B

否，因为该风险资本家没有义务披露股票的实际价值。

核心法律规则

一般原则： 在正常的商业交易（Arm's Length Transaction）中，一方通常没有义务向另一方披露所有重要事实。单纯的沉默（Silence）或不披露（Nondisclosure）通常不构成欺诈或虚假陈述。

要确立基于“不披露”的虚假陈述责任，原告必须证明被告有披露义务 (Duty to Disclose)。这种义务通常只在以下几种特殊情况下产生：

  1. 双方存在信托关系 (Fiduciary Relationship)（如受托人与受益人、律师与客户）。
  2. 为了纠正之前做出的误导性陈述（半真半假的话）。
  3. 一方对交易的基本事实存在误解，且另一方知情，且根据诚实信用原则应当披露（通常涉及隐蔽缺陷）。
案情深度解析

在本案中，风险资本家（VC）与股东（Shareholder）之间是完全的陌生人关系，属于典型的保持距离的商业交易 (Arm's Length Transaction)。

  • 无信托关系： VC不是股东的财务顾问或代理人，双方没有特殊的信任关系。
  • 信息公开： 股票的价值差异来源于“公开持有的公司”在其网站上发布的财务报表。这意味着该信息并非VC独有的内幕信息，股东本人也有同等机会获取。
  • 商业博弈： 买家试图低买，卖家试图高卖，这是市场的常态。当股东说“我认为值更多”时，VC保持沉默只是商业谈判策略，并非法律上的欺诈。

因此，由于VC没有披露义务，她的沉默不构成虚假陈述。选项 B 正确指出了这一法律依据。

易错项辨析
选项 C & D 错误：

这两个选项都错误地认为存在披露义务。在没有信托关系的情况下，仅仅因为一方拥有更多知识或另一方发表了评论，并不会自动产生披露义务。VC没有义务纠正股东对自己资产价值的错误判断，特别是当这些信息来源是公开的时候。

选项 A 错误：

虽然股东可以查阅报表是事实，但这并不是VC胜诉的根本法律原因。VC胜诉的根本原因是她没有披露义务。如果VC是股东的受托人（有义务），即使股东可以查阅报表，VC的沉默仍可能导致责任。因此，B比A更触及法律核心。

💡 MBE 实战技巧 在处理虚假陈述 (Misrepresentation) 题目时，首先区分是“主动撒谎”还是“保持沉默”。

如果是保持沉默 (Nondisclosure)，除非题目明确暗示存在信托关系 (Fiduciary Duty) 或隐瞒潜在缺陷 (Active Concealment)，否则被告通常不承担责任。记住：在自由市场中，买家没有义务告诉卖家“你的东西其实很值钱”。

A disgruntled science teacher had recently been fired from her job at the local high school. She told a parent, who was the communications chairperson for the high school's parent-teacher organization, that the principal was having an affair with the married assistant principal. The parent immediately sent a group email to all of the parents at the high school that included the following statement: "I'm not sure if this is true or not, but the science teacher said that the principal is having an affair with the assistant principal!"
The principal, who was not having an affair with the assistant principal, subsequently sued the parent for libel.
Is the principal likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the parent expressed a lack of knowledge as to the truthfulness of the science teacher's statement.
choices.b: No, because the parent identified the science teacher as the originator of the statement.
choices.c: Yes, because the original statement made by the science teacher was false.

questions.question:
A gas company built a large refining facility that conformed to zoning requirements on land near a landowner's property. The landowner had his own home and a mini-golf business on his property.
In a nuisance action against the gas company, the landowner established that the refinery emitted fumes that made many people feel quite sick when they were outside on his property for longer than a few minutes. The landowner's mini-golf business had greatly declined as a consequence, and the value of his property had gone down markedly.
Is the landowner likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the landowner has offered no evidence demonstrating that the gas company was negligent.
choices.b: No, because the refinery conforms to the zoning requirements.
choices.c: Yes, because the refinery has substantially and unreasonably interfered with the landowner's use and enjoyment of his property.
choices.d: Yes, because the value of the landowner's property has declined.

一家天然气公司在一块邻近某土地所有者物业的土地上，建造了一座符合区划规定的大型炼油设施。

该土地所有者在其物业上拥有自己的住宅和一个迷你高尔夫球场业务。

在对该天然气公司提起的滋扰诉讼中，该土地所有者证实，炼油厂排放的烟雾导致许多人在其物业的室外停留几分钟以上便会感到非常不适。因此，该土地所有者的迷你高尔夫业务大幅下滑，其物业价值也显著下降。

该土地所有者是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the landowner has offered no evidence demonstrating that the gas company was negligent.
不会，因为该土地所有者没有提供证据证明该天然气公司存在过失。

B. No, because the refinery conforms to the zoning requirements.
不会，因为炼油厂符合区划规定。

C. Yes, because the refinery has substantially and unreasonably interfered with the landowner's use and enjoyment of his property.
会，因为炼油厂实质性且不合理地干涉了该土地所有者对其物业的使用和享用。

D. Yes, because the value of the landowner's property has declined.
会，因为该土地所有者的物业价值下降了。
data.explanation:
A nuisance can be either public (interfering with a public right - eg, blocking a public highway) or private (interfering with a private property right - as seen here). Liability for private nuisance arises when the defendant's interference with the use and enjoyment of the plaintiff's property is both:

  • substantial - offensive, annoying, or intolerable to a normal person in the community and
  • unreasonable - the gravity of the plaintiff's harm outweighs the utility of the defendant's conduct.


Severe harm (eg, bodily harm to persons on the property) will always outweigh the utility of the defendant's conduct. Therefore, an interference that causes severe harm is unreasonable as a matter of law.

Here, the gas company's refinery substantially interfered with the use and enjoyment of the landowner's property (home and business) by emitting fumes that made people feel quite sick when they were on the property for more than a few minutes. And since the fumes caused physical illness (severe harm), that interference was unreasonable as a matter of law. Therefore, the landowner will likely prevail on his nuisance claim.

(Choice A) For private nuisance, the defendant's conduct must be tortious - but not necessarily negligent (ie, creating an unreasonable risk of interference). Therefore, the landowner can prevail even if he offers no evidence demonstrating that the gas company was negligent.

(Choice B) Compliance with zoning requirements - although not a complete defense to private nuisance - can help show that the defendant's interference was not unreasonable. But here, since the gas company's interference was unreasonable as a matter of law (because the company's fumes caused severe harm), the company's regulatory compliance is inconsequential.

(Choice D) Private nuisance allows the plaintiff to recover damages for a reduction in property value, but a reduction in property value is not required to prevail. Therefore, the landowner will likely prevail because the refinery substantially and unreasonably interfered with the use and enjoyment of his property - not because the value of the property has declined.

Educational objective: Private nuisance is a substantial and unreasonable interference with the use and enjoyment of the plaintiff's property. An interference is unreasonable as a matter of law when the plaintiff's harm is severe.



选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 1%，C选项 95%（正确选项），D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

滋扰可以是公共性的（干涉公共权利——例如，堵塞公共高速公路）或私人性的（干涉私人财产权——如本案所示）。当被告对原告物业的使用和享用造成的干涉同时满足以下两个条件时，便产生私人滋扰 (private nuisance) 的法律责任：

  • 实质性的——对社区中的普通人而言是冒犯性的、令人烦扰的或无法忍受的，并且
  • 不合理的——原告所受损害的严重性超过了被告行为的功用性。


严重损害（例如，对物业内人员的身体伤害）将总是超过被告行为的功用性。因此，造成严重损害的干涉在法律上即为不合理的 (unreasonable as a matter of law)。

在本案中，该天然气公司的炼油厂排放的烟雾，导致人们在其物业上停留几分钟以上便会感到非常不适，从而实质性地干涉了土地所有者对其物业（住宅和业务）的使用和享用。并且，由于烟雾造成了身体疾病（严重损害），该干涉在法律上即为不合理的。因此，该土地所有者很可能在其滋扰诉讼中胜诉。

（选项 A）对于私人滋扰，被告的行为必须构成侵权——但不一定是过失行为（即，造成不合理的干涉风险）。因此，即使土地所有者没有提供证据证明天然气公司存在过失，他仍然可以胜诉。

（选项 B）遵守区划规定——虽然不是对私人滋扰的完全抗辩——但可以帮助证明被告的干涉并非不合理。但在本案中，由于天然气公司的干涉在法律上即为不合理的（因为公司的烟雾造成了严重损害），因此该公司遵守法规的行为是无关紧要的。

（选项 D）私人滋扰允许原告就物业价值的减少获得损害赔偿，但物业价值的减少并非胜诉的必要条件。因此，该土地所有者可能胜诉的原因是炼油厂实质性且不合理地干涉了他对物业的使用和享用——而不是因为物业价值下降了。

教学目标：私人滋扰 (Private nuisance) 是指对原告使用和享用其物业的实质性且不合理的干涉。当原告所受的损害是严重的时，该干涉在法律上即为不合理的。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 822 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (private nuisance liability).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 821F (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (substantial harm requirement).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 826 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (unreasonable interference requirement).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 829A (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (severe harm is unreasonable).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Torts: Private Nuisance (侵权法：私人滋扰)

核心法律规则

私人滋扰 (Private Nuisance) 的定义是对他人使用和享用其土地的权利造成了实质性 (Substantial) 且 不合理 (Unreasonable) 的非侵入式干涉。

要赢得诉讼，原告必须证明以下两点：

  • 实质性干涉： 对社区普通人而言是冒犯性的或无法忍受的。
  • 不合理干涉： 这是一个平衡测试 (Balancing Test)。通常需要权衡“原告受到的伤害”与“被告行为的社会效用”。
⚠️ 关键例外 (本题考眼)：
如果干涉导致了严重伤害 (Severe Harm)，例如对物业内人员造成身体伤害或疾病，那么法律直接认定该干涉是不合理的 (Unreasonable as a matter of law)，无需再进行效用平衡。
本案逻辑推演
1. 是否存在干涉？
是。炼油厂排放的烟雾 (Fumes) 进入了原告土地。
2. 是否实质性？
是。烟雾导致人们感到“非常不适 (quite sick)”，这显然超过了普通人的忍受限度。
3. 是否不合理？
是。虽然炼油厂有经济价值，但它导致了身体疾病 (Physical sickness)。根据侵权法原则，造成严重身体伤害的干涉永远是不合理的。
✅ 正确答案：C

因为炼油厂实质性且不合理地干涉了土地所有者对其物业的使用和享用。

常见陷阱辨析
❌ 选项 A (过失陷阱)
错误原因： 滋扰 (Nuisance) 关注的是结果（干涉是否不合理），而不是被告的行为方式。即使被告尽了最大努力（没有过失），如果其故意行为（明知后果仍继续）导致了不合理的干涉，仍需承担责任。
❌ 选项 B (合规陷阱)
错误原因： 符合区划规定 (Zoning requirements) 只是证据之一，不是绝对抗辩 (Absolute defense)。即使合法经营，如果对邻居造成了严重伤害，依然构成滋扰。
❌ 选项 D (价值陷阱)
错误原因： 物业价值下降是损害赔偿 (Damages) 的计算依据，而不是构成滋扰的核心要素 (Element)。胜诉的根本原因是“干涉”本身，而非“贬值”。
🎓 MBE 提分技巧：
在处理 Nuisance 题目时，一旦看到事实描述中出现“身体不适”、“恶心”、“生病”等词语，这通常暗示干涉已经达到“严重伤害”的程度。此时，无论被告的生意多么重要（Utility），或者是否符合法规（Zoning），原告几乎总是会胜诉。

A popular sports magazine published an investigative article detailing the prohibited tactics used by a university football program to recruit and retain top players. The article stated that at least five players had received postgame cash from their coaches based on performance during the game. One of those players, the quarterback, was quoted as saying that he lived "rent-free at the ranch of a booster club member" who had told him, "I'll pay you $400 a week to shoe horses and shovel manure." The quarterback was further quoted as saying, "I never even touched a horse [at the ranch]."
Soon after the article was published, the booster club member was asked to leave the club because of the public outrage created by the article. The booster club member now seeks to file an action against the magazine, alleging that the quarterback did odd jobs to earn his keep and that the magazine had published the article with reckless disregard for its truthfulness.
Under which theory would the booster club member be most likely to recover?

choices.a: Intrusion upon seclusion.
choices.b: Public disclosure of private facts.
choices.c: Publicity in a false light.
choices.d: Slander.

questions.question:
At a country auction, a collector acquired an antique cabinet that he recognized as an extremely rare and valuable collector's item. Unfortunately, the cabinet had several coats of varnish and paint over the original finish. Its potential value could only be realized if these layers could be removed without damaging the original finish. Much of the value of the cabinet depended on the condition of a unique oil finish, the secret of which died with the cabinet's inventor.
A professional restorer of antique furniture recommended that the collector use a certain paint-stripping product to remove the paint and varnish from the cabinet. The collector obtained and read a sales brochure published by the manufacturer of the paint-stripping product. The brochure stated: "This product will renew all antique furniture. Will not damage original oil finishes."
The collector purchased this paint-stripping product and used it on his cabinet, being very careful to follow the accompanying instructions exactly. Despite the collector's care, the cabinet's original finish was irreparably damaged. When finally refinished, the cabinet was worth less than 20% of what it would have been worth if its original finish had been preserved.
If the collector sues the manufacturer of the paint-stripping product to recover the loss he has suffered as a result of the destruction of the cabinet's original finish, will the collector likely prevail?

choices.a: No, if the product was not dangerous to persons.
choices.b: No, unless the product was defective when sold by the manufacturer.
choices.c: Yes, if the loss would not have occurred had the statement in the brochure been true.
choices.d: Yes, unless no other known removal technique would have preserved the cabinet's original finish.

在一次乡村拍卖会上，一位收藏家购得一个古董柜。他认出这是一件极其稀有和珍贵的收藏品。不幸的是，这个柜子在原有的饰面之上被涂了好几层清漆和油漆。只有在不损坏原有饰面的情况下除去这些涂层，其潜在价值才能实现。这个柜子的价值在很大程度上取决于一种独特的油饰面状况，而其秘方已随柜子的发明者一同失传。

一位专业的古董家具修复师建议收藏家使用某种脱漆产品来去除柜子上的油漆和清漆。收藏家获取并阅读了该脱漆产品制造商发布的一份销售手册。手册上写道：“本产品将翻新所有古董家具。不会损坏原有的油饰面。”

收藏家购买了这款脱漆产品，并用在他的柜子上，非常小心地严格遵循附带的说明。尽管收藏家小心谨慎，柜子的原有饰面还是遭到了无法修复的损坏。最终重新上漆后，该柜子的价值不到其原有饰面得以保留时应有价值的20%。

如果收藏家起诉该脱漆产品的制造商，要求赔偿因柜子原有饰面被毁而遭受的损失，收藏家是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, if the product was not dangerous to persons.
不会，如果该产品对人身没有危险。

B. No, unless the product was defective when sold by the manufacturer.
不会，除非该产品在制造商出售时存在缺陷。

C. Yes, if the loss would not have occurred had the statement in the brochure been true.
会，如果手册中的陈述属实，损失就不会发生。

D. Yes, unless no other known removal technique would have preserved the cabinet's original finish.
会，除非没有其他已知的清除技术能够保全该柜子的原有饰面。

Products liability claims


ClaimsRequired elements
Strict products liabilityCommercial seller produced or sold defective product
Product caused plaintiff harm
NegligenceSeller (commercial or noncommercial) failed to use reasonable care in producing or inspecting defective product
Product caused plaintiff harm
Intentional tortSeller (commercial or noncommercial) purposefully or knowingly produced or sold defective product
Product caused plaintiff harm
Misrepresentation†Commercial seller misrepresented material fact about product
Consumer justifiably relied on misrepresentation when purchasing product
Product caused plaintiff harm
Warranty
Merchantability (implied)		Commercial seller warranted product is generally acceptable & reasonably fit for its ordinary purpose
Warranty
Fitness for particular purpose (implied)		Seller (commercial or noncommercial) warranted product is fit for particular purpose
Purchaser relied on seller's judgment or skill to purchase product
Warranty
Express		Seller (commercial or noncommercial) made affirmation of fact or promise that is part of basis of bargain
†Commercial sellers are strictly liable for the misrepresentations they make regarding their products - regardless of whether those products are defective.

A commercial seller (ie, manufacturer, distributor, retailer) is subject to strict liability for harm caused by defective products. In addition, a commercial seller can be strictly liable for misrepresentations regarding any of its products - regardless of whether that product is defective. To recover based on misrepresentation, the plaintiff must show that:
  • the commercial seller misrepresented a material fact about a product - ie, a fact that would be important to a normal purchaser
  • the plaintiff justifiably relied on that misrepresentation when purchasing the product and
  • the product caused the plaintiff physical harm - ie, harm that would not have occurred had the seller's representation been true.
Here, the manufacturer's brochure falsely stated that its paint-stripping product "[w]ill not damage original oil finishes" (misrepresentation). The collector read the brochure before purchasing the product to use on his antique cabinet (justifiable reliance). And since the destruction of the cabinet's original finish would not have occurred had the statement in the brochure been true (causation), the collector will likely prevail.

(Choice A) Products liability based on misrepresentation applies to any type of physical harm (ie, personal injury or property damage), so the fact that this product was not dangerous to persons would not absolve the manufacturer of liability.

(Choice B) A commercial seller is strictly liable for harm caused by its misrepresentations about any of its products - not just defective ones.

(Choice D) Products liability can be based on a commercial seller's misrepresentation about a product even if no other product can satisfy that representation.

Educational objective: Products liability based on misrepresentation arises when (1) a commercial seller misrepresented a material fact about a product, (2) the plaintiff justifiably relied on that misrepresentation, and (3) the product caused the plaintiff physical harm.

选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 20%，C选项 69%（正确选项），D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

产品责任索赔


索赔类型构成要件
Strict products liability (严格产品责任)商业销售者生产或销售了有缺陷的产品
产品对原告造成了损害
Negligence (过失)销售者（商业或非商业）在生产或检验有缺陷产品时未能尽到合理注意
产品对原告造成了损害
Intentional tort (故意侵权)销售者（商业或非商业）故意或明知而生产或销售有缺陷的产品
产品对原告造成了损害
Misrepresentation (虚假陈述)†商业销售者对产品的重大事实作出了虚假陈述
消费者在购买产品时正当地信赖了该虚假陈述
产品对原告造成了损害
Warranty (保证)
Merchantability (默示适销性)		商业销售者保证产品是普遍可接受的，并合理地适合其通常用途
Warranty (保证)
Fitness for particular purpose (默示特定用途适用性)		销售者（商业或非商业）保证产品适合特定用途
购买者依赖销售者的判断或技能来购买产品
Warranty (保证)
Express (明示)		销售者（商业或非商业）作出的事实确认或承诺，并构成交易基础的一部分
†商业销售者对其产品的虚假陈述承担严格责任——无论这些产品是否有缺陷。

商业销售者（即制造商、分销商、零售商）对因有缺陷产品造成的损害承担严格责任。此外，商业销售者可能因对其任何产品的虚假陈述而承担严格责任——无论该产品是否有缺陷。要基于虚假陈述获得赔偿，原告必须证明：
  • 商业销售者对产品的重大事实作出了虚假陈述——即对一个普通购买者而言很重要的事实
  • 原告在购买产品时正当地信赖了该虚假陈述并且
  • 产品对原告造成了人身或财产损害——即如果销售者的陈述属实，这种损害就不会发生。
在本案中，制造商的手册虚假地陈述其脱漆产品“不会损坏原有的油饰面”（虚假陈述）。收藏家在购买产品用于其古董柜之前阅读了该手册（正当信赖）。并且，如果手册中的陈述属实，柜子原有饰面的损坏就不会发生（因果关系），因此收藏家很可能胜诉。

(选项A) 基于虚假陈述的产品责任适用于任何类型的人身或财产损害（即人身伤害或财产损害），因此，该产品对人身没有危险这一事实并不能免除制造商的责任。

(选项B) 商业销售者对其任何产品的虚假陈述所造成的损害均承担严格责任——不仅仅是针对有缺陷的产品。

(选项D) 即使没有其他产品能满足该陈述，产品责任也可以基于商业销售者对产品的虚假陈述而成立。

教学目标： 基于虚假陈述的产品责任在以下情况产生：(1) 商业销售者对产品的重大事实作出了虚假陈述，(2) 原告正当地信赖了该虚假陈述，以及 (3) 产品对原告造成了人身或财产损害。

References

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 402B (Am. Law Inst. 1965) (explaining that a commercial seller is subject to strict liability for physical harm caused by its misrepresentations regarding its products).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Torts: Products Liability (Misrepresentation)
核心考点：虚假陈述 (Misrepresentation)

本题考查的是基于虚假陈述 (Misrepresentation) 的产品严格责任。这与基于产品缺陷 (Defect) 的责任不同。

依据：《侵权法重述（第二版）》§ 402B

如果商业销售者通过广告、标签或手册对产品的性质或质量做出了公开的虚假陈述，即使产品本身没有设计或制造缺陷，销售者仍需对因消费者正当信赖 (Justifiable Reliance) 该陈述而遭受的物理损害承担严格责任。

⚖️ 案情三步分析

  • 1
    虚假陈述 (Misrepresentation)
    制造商在手册中明确承诺：“不会损坏原有的油饰面” (Will not damage original oil finishes)。这是一个关于产品质量的重大事实陈述。
  • 2
    正当信赖 (Justifiable Reliance)
    收藏家阅读了手册，并基于该承诺购买并使用了产品。这种信赖是合理的。
  • 3
    因果关系与损害 (Causation & Harm)
    产品实际上损坏了饰面。如果手册的陈述是真的（即产品不伤饰面），损失就不会发生。

✅ 为什么选 C？

选项 C 正确：

“如果手册中的陈述属实，损失就不会发生。”

这句话确立了因果关系和陈述的虚假性。既然损失发生了，说明陈述是假的。根据 § 402B，只要存在虚假陈述且导致了物理损害（包括财产损失），制造商就必须承担责任，无需证明产品有“缺陷”。

❌ 陷阱排除

选项 A 错误观点：仅限人身伤害
基于虚假陈述的严格责任适用于所有物理损害 (Physical Harm)，这既包括对人的伤害，也包括对财产 (Chattels) 的损害。
选项 B 常见陷阱：必须有缺陷
这是最大的干扰项。对于普通的严格产品责任 (§ 402A)，产品确实需要有“缺陷”。但对于虚假陈述 (§ 402B)，只要产品未能达到其宣称的性能，即使产品本身设计完美、制造无误，制造商也要负责。
选项 D 错误观点：无其他替代方案
是否有其他技术能保存饰面与本案无关。关键在于制造商做出了特定的承诺（“本产品不会损坏...”），而该承诺未兑现。
💡 MBE 提分技巧

看到题目中有具体的承诺（如“防碎”、“防爆”、“不伤漆”）且该承诺未兑现时，优先考虑 Misrepresentation 理论，而不是普通的 Defect 理论。此时，产品是否有“缺陷”不再是关键，关键是它是否“撒谎”了。

questions.question:
A college junior applied for membership in a college honor society. One of the current members of the society, an academic rival of the junior, sent an email to the other members of the society claiming that the junior was an alcoholic. Although some of the members believed the email, most did not. Consequently, the junior was admitted to the society. The junior subsequently sued her rival for libel. At trial, the junior established that she had never consumed alcohol and that her rival knew this. The rival offered proof that the junior was a user of illegal drugs at the time of the email.
Is the junior likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because she failed to prove that a third party acted adversely toward her.
choices.b: No, because she was a user of illegal drugs.
choices.c: Yes, because of the doctrine of libel per quod.
choices.d: Yes, because she is entitled to general damages for reputational harm.

一名大三学生申请加入一个大学荣誉社团。该社团的一名现任成员，也是这名大三学生的学术竞争对手，向社团其他成员发送了一封电子邮件，声称该大三学生是酗酒者。尽管有些成员相信了这封邮件，但大多数人不相信。因此，这名大三学生被接纳加入了该社团。该大三学生随后以书面诽谤为由起诉了她的竞争对手。在审判中，该大三学生证明了她从未饮酒，并且她的竞争对手知道这一点。竞争对手提供了证据，证明该大三学生在发送邮件时是违禁药物的使用者。

该大三学生有可能胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because she was a user of illegal drugs.
不会，因为她是违禁药物的使用者。

B. No, because she was admitted to the honor society.
不会，因为她被接纳加入了荣誉社团。

C. Yes, because of the doctrine of libel per quod.
会，因为适用 间接书面诽谤（libel per quod）原则。

D. Yes, because she is entitled to general damages.
会，因为她有权获得一般性损害赔偿。
data.explanation:
Libel is defamation in words written, printed, or otherwise recorded in permanent form. Most courts addressing the issue have held that email messages are categorized as libel. A libel claim requires proof of the following:
  • The defendant knowingly made a false statement about the plaintiff or negligently failed to determine its falsity.
  • The statement was defamatory, meaning that the statement would have a general tendency to harm the plaintiff's reputation.
  • The defendant intentionally or negligently communicated the statement to a third party.
Once proved, the plaintiff can recover general damages, which are any damages that compensate the plaintiff for harm to the plaintiff's reputation. Reputational harm can be presumed for libel because it is more permanent and more easily spread than slander (ie, spoken defamation).

Here, the rival's email claimed that the junior was an alcoholic even though the rival knew that the junior had never consumed alcohol. That statement would have a general tendency to harm the junior's reputation. And since the rival intentionally communicated the statement to third parties by emailing the other members of the honor society, the junior is entitled to recover general damages. Therefore, the junior will likely prevail.

(Choice A) Even if the junior was a user of illegal drugs at the time of the email, she was not an alcoholic, so the rival's statement was false.

(Choice B) Special damages are a prerequisite to recovery for slander and require the plaintiff to prove that a third party acted adversely to the plaintiff as a result of the defendant's defamatory statement. But since the junior sued for libel, the fact that she was admitted to the honor society (no adverse action) is irrelevant.

(Choice C) The doctrine of libel per quod applies when reference to extrinsic facts is needed to show that the statement is defamatory (not seen here).

Educational objective: Libel is defamation by words written, printed, or otherwise recorded in permanent form (eg, emails). A libel plaintiff can recover general damages to compensate the plaintiff for the presumed harm to his/her reputation.



选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 36%，C选项 20%，D选项 38%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

书面诽谤 (Libel) 是以书面、印刷或其他永久形式记录的文字进行的诽谤。大多数处理此问题的法院都认为电子邮件属于书面诽谤的范畴。一项书面诽谤的诉讼主张需要证明以下几点：
  • 被告明知故犯地对原告作出了虚假陈述，或因过失未能确定其虚假性。
  • 该陈述具有诽谤性，即该陈述通常会损害原告的声誉。
  • 被告故意或因过失将该陈述传达给了第三方。
一旦得到证实，原告可以获得一般性损害赔偿 (general damages)，这是为补偿原告声誉受到的损害而支付的任何赔偿金。对于书面诽谤，可以推定存在声誉损害 (Reputational harm)，因为它比口头诽谤 (slander，即口头形式的诽谤) 更持久，也更容易传播。

在本案中，竞争对手的电子邮件声称该大三学生是酗酒者，尽管竞争对手知道该学生从未饮酒。该陈述通常会损害该大三学生的声誉。并且，由于竞争对手通过向荣誉社团的其他成员发送电子邮件，故意将该陈述传达给了第三方，因此该大三学生有权获得一般性损害赔偿。因此，该大三学生很可能胜诉。

(选项A) 即使该大三学生在发送邮件时是违禁药物的使用者，她也不是酗酒者，因此竞争对手的陈述是虚假的。

(选项B) 特殊损害赔偿 (Special damages) 是从口头诽谤 (slander) 中获得赔偿的先决条件，它要求原告证明第三方因被告的诽谤性陈述而对原告采取了不利行动。但由于该大三学生是就书面诽谤 (libel) 提起诉讼，她被荣誉社团接纳（即没有不利行动）这一事实是无关紧要的。

(选项C) 间接书面诽谤 (libel per quod) 原则适用于需要引用外部事实才能证明陈述具有诽谤性的情况（本案中未出现）。

教学目的：书面诽谤 (Libel) 是指以书面、印刷或其他永久形式（如电子邮件）记录的文字进行的诽谤。书面诽谤案的原告可以获得一般性损害赔偿，以补偿其被推定的声誉损害。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 568 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (distinguishing libel and slander).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 621 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (explaining that general damages are imposed to compensate the plaintiff for reputational harm).

MBE 考点解析

侵权法 (Torts) - 诽谤 (Defamation)
核心考点：书面诽谤与损害赔偿

本题的正确答案是 D。要理解为什么，我们需要掌握以下法律逻辑：

书面诽谤 (Libel)
指以书面、印刷、电子邮件或其他永久形式记录的诽谤性言论。
形式判定：被告发送的是电子邮件 (Email)。在法律上，电子邮件被视为书面形式，因此本案属于书面诽谤 (Libel)，而非口头诽谤 (Slander)。
损害赔偿规则：普通法的一个关键原则是：对于书面诽谤，法律推定原告遭受了声誉损害。
结论：原告无需证明具体的经济损失（即特殊损害赔偿，Special Damages）。只要证明了诽谤成立，她就有权获得一般性损害赔偿 (General Damages)，以补偿其声誉受到的伤害。
为什么选 D？

选项 D 指出原告有权获得“一般性损害赔偿”。这是书面诽谤诉讼的核心特征。

虽然原告最终加入了社团（没有遭受实际的职业或经济阻碍），但这并不妨碍她胜诉。因为在 Libel 案件中，声誉受损本身就是一种伤害，不需要额外的证据来证明“我因此丢了工作”或“我因此没进社团”。

陷阱选项解析
❌ 选项 A：因为她是违禁药物使用者

考点：真实性抗辩 (Truth Defense)

虽然“真实性”是诽谤罪的绝对抗辩理由，但它必须针对被指控的具体内容。被告称原告是“酗酒者 (Alcoholic)”，而原告证明了自己从未饮酒。被告证明原告“吸毒”并不能证明“酗酒”的指控是真的。这是两个不同的事实。

❌ 选项 B：因为她被接纳加入了社团

考点：特殊损害 (Special Damages) vs. 一般损害

如果这是口头诽谤 (Slander) 且不属于“本身诽谤 (Slander Per Se)”的范畴，原告确实需要证明遭受了实际损失（如被拒绝入会）。但对于书面诽谤 (Libel)，不需要证明这种具体后果。

❌ 选项 C：间接书面诽谤 (Libel Per Quod)

考点：法律术语辨析

Libel Per Quod 指的是那些表面看没问题，需要结合外部事实才构成诽谤的言论。本案中，称某人为“酗酒者”本身就具有诽谤性 (Defamatory on its face)，不需要外部事实佐证，因此不适用此原则。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

在处理诽谤 (Defamation) 题目时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 区分形式：是口头 (Slander) 还是书面 (Libel)？（Email, 广播, 电视通常视为 Libel）。
  2. 检查损害要求：
    • 如果是 Libel → 通常推定有损害 (Presumed Damages)。
    • 如果是 Slander → 通常需证明金钱损失 (Special Damages)，除非涉及四大类“本身诽谤” (Slander Per Se: 犯罪、恶疾、职业不端、性不检点)。
  3. 检查抗辩：内容是否真实？是否享有特权 (Privilege)？

questions.question:
A food company contracted with a delivery service to supply food to remote areas around the world. The contract between the food company and the delivery service was terminable at will. The delivery service then entered into a contract with an airline to provide an airplane to deliver the food. The contract between the delivery service and the airline was also terminable at will.
The food company was displeased with the airline because of a previous business dispute between them. Upon learning of the delivery service's contract with the airline, the food company terminated its contract with the delivery service in order to cause the airline to lose the business. After the food company terminated the delivery service's contract, the delivery service had no choice but to terminate the airline contract.
If the airline sues the delivery service for tortious interference with contract, will the airline prevail?

choices.a: No, because the airline and the delivery service were the parties to the contract.
choices.b: No, because the airline was not in privity with the food company.
choices.c: Yes, because the delivery service did not terminate the contract because of poor performance.
choices.d: Yes, because the delivery service's termination of the contract made it a party to the food company's acts.

data.questionStem:
Q83150

A food company contracted with a delivery service to supply food to remote areas around the world. The contract between the food company and the delivery service was terminable at will. The delivery service then entered into a contract with an airline to provide an airplane to deliver the food. The contract between the delivery service and the airline was also terminable at will.

The food company was displeased with the airline because of a previous business dispute between them. Upon learning of the delivery service's contract with the airline, the food company terminated its contract with the delivery service in order to cause the airline to lose the business. After the food company terminated the delivery service's contract, the delivery service had no choice but to terminate the airline contract.

If the airline sues the delivery service for tortious interference with contract, will the airline prevail?

一家食品公司与一家送货服务公司签订合同，向世界各地的偏远地区供应食品。食品公司与送货服务公司之间的合同可任意终止。该送货服务公司随后与一家航空公司签订合同，由其提供飞机运送食品。送货服务公司与航空公司之间的合同也是可任意终止的。

由于先前存在商业纠纷，食品公司对该航空公司感到不满。在得知送货服务公司与航空公司的合同后，食品公司终止了与送货服务公司的合同，意图使航空公司失去该业务。在食品公司终止了与送货服务公司的合同后，送货服务公司别无选择，只能终止与航空公司的合同。

如果航空公司以 tortious interference with contract 为由起诉送货服务公司，航空公司会胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because the airline and the delivery service were the parties to the contract.
不会，因为航空公司和送货服务公司是合同的当事人。

B. No, because the airline was not in privity with the food company.
不会，因为航空公司与食品公司之间不存在合同相对性（privity）。

C. Yes, because the delivery service did not terminate the contract because of poor performance.
会，因为送货服务公司并非因履约不力而终止合同。

D. Yes, because the delivery service's termination of the contract made it a party to the food company's acts.
会，因为送货服务公司终止合同的行为使其成为了食品公司行为的参与方。
data.explanation:
To prevail on a tortious interference with contract claim, the plaintiff must prove all of the following:
  • A valid contract existed between the plaintiff and a third party.
  • The defendant intentionally and improperly interfered with the contract's performance - eg, using physical violence or economic pressure to prevent or hinder performance of the contract.
  • The interference caused the plaintiff pecuniary (monetary) loss.
Therefore, the plaintiff can only prevail if the defendant interfered with a contract between the plaintiff and a third party - not a contract between the plaintiff and the defendant.

Here, the delivery service (defendant) entered into a contract with the airline (plaintiff). Although the delivery service terminated that contract, the delivery service is not liable for tortious interference with contract because the delivery service interfered with its own contract with the airline - not a contract between the airline and a third party (eg, the food company). Therefore, the airline will not prevail.

(Choice B) The airline's claim for tortious interference with contract will fail because the contract at issue involves the airline (plaintiff) and the delivery service (defendant) - not the airline and a third party. Therefore, the airline's lack of privity (ie, contractual relationship) with the food company (third party) is inconsequential.

(Choice C) Since the airline's suit stems from the airline's contract with the delivery service, the claim against the delivery service should be based on that contract (eg, breach of contract) - not tort (eg, tortious interference with contract). And since the contract was terminable at will, the contract could be terminated by either party for any reason - not just poor performance.

(Choice D) The food company's acts forced the delivery service to terminate its contract with the airline, but did not make the delivery service a party to (or liable for) the food company's acts.

Educational objective: Tortious interference with contract requires proof that (1) a valid contract existed between the plaintiff and a third party, (2) the defendant intentionally and improperly interfered with the contract's performance, and (3) that interference caused the plaintiff pecuniary loss.



选项正确率统计：A选项 47%（正确选项），B选项 26%，C选项 14%，D选项 11%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

要在 tortious interference with contract 索赔中胜诉，原告必须证明以下所有内容：
  • 原告与第三方之间存在有效合同。
  • 被告故意且不正当地干涉了合同的履行——例如，使用物理暴力或经济压力来阻止或妨碍合同的履行。
  • 该干涉给原告造成了金钱（pecuniary）损失。
因此，只有当被告干涉了原告与第三方之间的合同时，原告才能胜诉——而不是干涉原告与被告之间的合同。

在本案中，送货服务公司（被告）与航空公司（原告）签订了合同。尽管送货服务公司终止了该合同，但其对 tortious interference with contract 不承担责任，因为送货服务公司干涉的是其自己与航空公司的合同——而不是航空公司与第三方（例如，食品公司）之间的合同。因此，航空公司不会胜诉。

(选项 B) 航空公司关于 tortious interference with contract 的索赔将会失败，因为争议中的合同涉及的是航空公司（原告）和送货服务公司（被告）——而不是航空公司和第三方。因此，航空公司与食品公司（第三方）之间缺乏合同相对性（privity）（即合同关系）是无关紧要的。

(选项 C) 由于航空公司的诉讼源于其与送货服务公司的合同，因此对送货服务公司的索赔应基于该合同（例如，违约）——而不是侵权行为（例如，tortious interference with contract）。并且，由于该合同是可任意终止的，任何一方都可以因任何理由终止合同——而不仅仅是因为履约不力。

(选项 D) 食品公司的行为迫使送货服务公司终止了与航空公司的合同，但这并未使送货服务公司成为食品公司行为的参与方（或为其行为承担责任）。

教学目标： Tortious interference with contract 要求证明 (1) 原告与第三方之间存在有效合同，(2) 被告故意且不正当地干涉了合同的履行，以及 (3) 该干涉给原告造成了金钱损失。

References

Restatement (Second) of Torts §§ 766, 766A (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (intentional interference with contract).

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 767 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (improper interference requirement).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Tortious Interference with Contract
⚖️ 核心法律规则

Tortious Interference with Contract（合同侵权干涉）是一项侵权行为，其核心要素要求被告必须是合同之外的第三方（Third Party）。

合同的一方当事人（Party to the contract）不能因为“干涉”自己的合同而被起诉侵权。如果一方当事人破坏合同，那属于Breach of Contract（违约），而非侵权。

🔍 案情拆解

本案中的法律关系如下：

  • 原告 (Plaintiff): 航空公司 (Airline)
  • 被告 (Defendant): 送货服务公司 (Delivery Service)
  • 争议合同: 航空公司与送货服务公司之间的运输合同

航空公司起诉的理由是 Tortious Interference。然而，被告（送货服务公司）本身就是该合同的签约方。

💡 逻辑推演

要赢得 Tortious Interference 的诉讼，原告必须证明被告干涉了原告与第三方之间的合同。

在本案中，送货服务公司终止的是它自己与航空公司的合同。无论其动机是被食品公司逼迫还是其他原因，这在法律上只能被视为合同行为（履约或违约），而不构成对该合同的“侵权干涉”。

因此，航空公司无法胜诉。

✅ 正确答案：A
因为航空公司和送货服务公司是合同的当事人。
🚫 干扰项排除
选项 B (Privity): 错误。Privity（合同相对性）通常用于合同诉讼。但在侵权诉讼中，关键是被告是否为第三方。航空公司与食品公司是否有 Privity 与本案（起诉送货公司）无关。
选项 C (Performance): 错误。合同是 Terminable at will（可任意终止），意味着可以因任何理由终止，不需要证明履约不力。但这属于合同法抗辩，而本题考点在于侵权法的主体资格。
选项 D (Party to acts): 错误。虽然是被迫的，但送货公司终止合同是其独立行为。更重要的是，即使它参与了食品公司的计划，作为合同当事人，它依然不能对自己签署的合同承担“侵权干涉”责任。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧

看到 Tortious Interference 的题目时，第一步先画出人物关系图：

Plaintiff <--> Third Party (合同关系)

Defendant (外部干扰者)

如果 Defendant 是合同的一方，直接排除侵权责任，该选项通常就是正确答案。

questions.question:
A board-certified vascular surgeon applied for privileges at a newly built hospital to expand his practice. The chief of vascular surgery at the hospital decided to sabotage the surgeon's application in order to maintain exclusive control over the vascular surgery department. The chief told the hospital's board members, who were responsible for reviewing the surgeon's application, that she had received disturbing data about his practice's unusually high patient-mortality rates. She then presented the board with data that she had fabricated. The board was disturbed by the fabricated data and therefore decided to reject the surgeon's application.
As a result of the board's decision to reject his application, the surgeon is unable to perform surgeries at the newly built hospital. The surgeon claims that his practice has suffered pecuniary losses in the form of lost revenue. He has sought the advice of his attorney regarding which action against the chief of vascular surgery is most likely to succeed.
What sort of action against the chief of vascular surgery should the attorney recommend?

choices.a: Intentional interference with an existing contract.
choices.b: Intentional misrepresentation of the mortality rates of the surgeon's practice.
choices.c: Slander of title regarding the ownership of the surgeon's practice.
choices.d: Trade libel for a false statement regarding the surgeon's practice.

questions.question:
A businesswoman owns a tract of land in fee simple, and an environmentalist owns the adjoining tract of land in fee simple. The businesswoman has kept the lawns and trees on her land trimmed and neat. The environmentalist "lets nature take its course" on his land. The result on the environmentalist's land is a tangle of underbrush, fallen trees, and standing trees that are in danger of losing limbs. Many of the trees on the environmentalist's land are near the businesswoman's property line. In the past, debris and large limbs have been blown from the environmentalist's land onto the businesswoman's land. By local standards the environmentalist's land is an eyesore that depresses market values of real property in the vicinity, but the condition of the land violates no applicable laws or ordinances.
The businesswoman has demanded that the environmentalist keep the trees near her land trimmed. The environmentalist has refused.
The businesswoman brought an appropriate action against the environmentalist to require him to abate what she alleges to be a nuisance. In the lawsuit, the only issue is whether the condition of the environmentalist's land constitutes a nuisance.
What is the businesswoman's strongest argument?

choices.a: The condition of the environmentalist's land cannot otherwise be challenged under any law or ordinance.
choices.b: The condition of the environmentalist's land has an adverse impact on real estate values.
choices.c: The condition of the environmentalist's land poses a danger to the occupants of her land.
choices.d: The condition of the environmentalist's land violates community aesthetic standards.

data.questionStem:
Q83190

A businesswoman owns a tract of land in fee simple, and an environmentalist owns the adjoining tract of land in fee simple. The businesswoman has kept the lawns and trees on her land trimmed and neat. The environmentalist "lets nature take its course" on his land. The result on the environmentalist's land is a tangle of underbrush, fallen trees, and standing trees that are in danger of losing limbs. Many of the trees on the environmentalist's land are near the businesswoman's property line. In the past, debris and large limbs have been blown from the environmentalist's land onto the businesswoman's land. By local standards the environmentalist's land is an eyesore that depresses market values of real property in the vicinity, but the condition of the land violates no applicable laws or ordinances.

The businesswoman has demanded that the environmentalist keep the trees near her land trimmed. The environmentalist has refused.

The businesswoman brought an appropriate action against the environmentalist to require him to abate what she alleges to be a nuisance. In the lawsuit, the only issue is whether the condition of the environmentalist's land constitutes a nuisance.

What is the businesswoman's strongest argument?

一位女商人以完全保有地权（fee simple）的形式拥有一块土地，一位环保主义者以同样的形式拥有相邻的土地。女商人一直保持其土地上的草坪和树木修剪整齐。环保主义者则任由其土地“自然发展”。其结果是，环保主义者的土地上灌木丛生，树木倒塌，还有一些可能断裂树枝的直立树木。环保主义者土地上的许多树木靠近女商人的地界线。过去，环保主义者土地上的杂物和巨大树枝曾被风吹到女商人的土地上。根据当地标准，环保主义者的土地有碍观瞻，拉低了附近不动产的市场价值，但该土地的状况并未违反任何适用的法律或条例。

女商人已要求环保主义者修剪其靠近她土地的树木。环保主义者已拒绝。

女商人对环保主义者提起了适当的诉讼，要求他消除她所声称的妨害（nuisance）。在该诉讼中，唯一的问题是环保主义者土地的状况是否构成妨害。

女商人最有力的论点是什么？
options:
A. The condition of the environmentalist's land cannot otherwise be challenged under any law or ordinance.
环保主义者土地的状况无法依据任何其他法律或条例提出质疑。

B. The condition of the environmentalist's land has an adverse impact on real estate values.
环保主义者土地的状况对房地产价值产生了不利影响。

C. The condition of the environmentalist's land poses a danger to the occupants of her land.
环保主义者土地的状况对她土地上的居住者构成了危险。

D. The condition of the environmentalist's land violates community aesthetic standards.
环保主义者土地的状况违反了社区的审美标准。
data.explanation:
Private nuisance is a substantial and unreasonable interference with the use and enjoyment of the plaintiff's property. An interference arising from a natural condition on land (eg, encroaching trees or plants) is generally not a nuisance. However, some courts have held that a natural condition on land may be a nuisance if it caused - or poses an imminent danger of - actual harm to adjoining property or those on it.

Here, the environmentalist has kept his land in its natural condition. As a result, debris and large tree limbs from his land have blown onto the businesswoman's property in the past. And since many of the environmentalist's trees are near the businesswoman's property line and in danger of losing limbs, her strongest argument for why the environmentalist's land constitutes a nuisance is that the condition of his land poses an imminent danger to the occupants of her land.

(Choice A) Compliance with the law is one factor that weighs in favor of a finding that the interference was not unreasonable. Therefore, the fact that the condition of the environmentalist's land cannot be challenged under any law or ordinance favors the environmentalist - not the businesswoman.

(Choices B & D) A natural condition on land can only support a private nuisance claim if the condition caused - or poses an imminent danger of - actual harm to adjoining property or those on it. Adverse impacts on real estate values and violations of community aesthetic standards do not cause - or pose an imminent danger of - actual harm to adjoining property or those on it. Therefore, these are not the businesswoman's strongest arguments.

Educational objective: An interference arising from a natural condition on land is generally not a nuisance. However, some courts have held that a natural condition may be a nuisance if it caused, or poses an imminent danger of, actual harm to adjoining property or those on it.



选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 20%，C选项 67%（正确选项），D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

私人妨害（Private nuisance）是指对原告财产的使用和享用构成实质性且不合理的干涉。由土地上的自然状况（例如，侵入的树木或植物）引起的干涉通常不构成妨害。然而，一些法院认为，如果土地上的自然状况对邻近财产或其上的人员造成了——或构成了迫在眉睫的危险——实际损害，则可能构成妨害。

在本案中，环保主义者使其土地保持在自然状态。因此，过去他土地上的杂物和巨大树枝曾被吹到女商人的财产上。并且，由于环保主义者的许多树木靠近女商人的地界线且有断裂树枝的危险，她主张环保主义者土地构成妨害的最有力论点是，其土地状况对她土地上的居住者构成了迫在眉睫的危险。

（选项 A）遵守法律是支持认定干涉并非不合理的一个因素。因此，环保主义者土地的状况不能根据任何法律或条例提出质疑这一事实，对环保主义者有利——而非对女商人有利。

（选项 B 和 D）只有当土地上的自然状况对邻近财产或其上的人员造成了——或构成了迫在眉睫的危险——实际损害时，才能支持私人妨害的索赔。对房地产价值的不利影响和违反社区审美标准，并不会对邻近财产或其上的人员造成——或构成迫在眉睫的危险——实际损害。因此，这些不是女商人最有力的论点。

教学目标：由土地上的自然状况引起的干涉通常不构成妨害。然而，一些法院认为，如果自然状况对邻近财产或其上的人员造成了实际损害，或构成了造成实际损害的迫在眉睫的危险，则可能构成妨害。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 821D (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (private nuisance).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 840 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (failure to abate harmful natural condition on land).

MBE 考点解析

侵权法 (Torts) - 私人妨害
核心法律原则：土地自然状况与妨害

在普通法（Common Law）的传统规则下，土地所有者通常无需对土地上的自然状况（Natural Conditions，如原生树木、杂草）对他人的干扰负责。

但是，现代法院（及本题考点）承认一个重要例外：

如果自然状况（特别是腐烂的树木）对邻近土地或其上的人员构成了不合理的危险（Unreasonable Danger）或造成了实际的物理伤害，土地所有者可能有义务消除这种妨害。

正确答案 C 论点分析

"环保主义者土地的状况对她土地上的居住者构成了危险。"

为什么这是最有力的论点？

  • 妨害的核心要素：私人妨害（Private Nuisance）是对他人使用和享用土地的“实质性且不合理的干涉”（Substantial and unreasonable interference）。
  • 安全 > 审美：虽然法律通常容忍邻居的土地“难看”，但绝不容忍邻居的土地“危险”。
  • 事实结合：题目提到树木“有断裂树枝的危险”（in danger of losing limbs）且过去已有杂物吹落。这种物理伤害的迫切威胁（Imminent danger of physical harm）打破了“自然状况免责”的一般原则。
选项 B & D 错误 房地产价值与审美标准

仅仅因为邻居的土地难看（Eyesore）或导致你的房价下跌，通常不足以构成法律上的妨害。妨害法保护的是土地的使用权，而不是投资价值或审美偏好。除非伴随物理干扰（如恶臭、噪音、烟尘或危险），否则纯粹的审美抱怨很难胜诉。

选项 A 错误 未违反其他法律

这是一个对被告（环保主义者）有利的论点，而不是原告。如果被告的行为完全合法（Compliant with laws），这证明他的行为可能是合理的，这削弱了原告关于“妨害”的主张。

💡 MBE 答题技巧

在处理 Nuisance（妨害） 问题时，请遵循以下优先级判断“不合理性”：

  1. 物理伤害/健康风险（最高优先级，如本题的断枝危险）。
  2. 物理入侵（如烟雾、震动、噪音）。
  3. 纯粹的经济/审美损失（最低优先级，通常不构成妨害）。

当题目问“最有力的论点”时，永远选择涉及人身安全或物理损坏的选项。

questions.question:
The personnel director of an investment company told a job applicant during an interview that the company was worth millions of dollars and that the company's portfolio would triple in the next several months. The applicant was very excited about the company's prospects and accepted an offer to work for the company. Two days later, the applicant read in the newspaper that the investment company had filed for bankruptcy reorganization. As a result of reading this news, the applicant suffered severe emotional distress, but he immediately found another comparable position.
Is the applicant likely to prevail in an action for negligent misrepresentation?

choices.a: No, because the applicant did not suffer any physical injury or pecuniary loss.
choices.b: No, because the personnel director's statement was purely speculative.
choices.c: Yes, because the applicant relied on the personnel director's misrepresentations about the investment company.
choices.d: Yes, because the personnel director should have foreseen that his misrepresentations would cause the applicant to be distressed.

Q83171

The applicant was very excited about the company's prospects and accepted an offer to work for the company. Two days later, the applicant read in the newspaper that the investment company had filed for bankruptcy reorganization. As a result of reading this news, the applicant suffered severe emotional distress, but he immediately found another comparable position.

Is the applicant likely to prevail in an action for negligent misrepresentation?

一家投资公司的人事总监在面试中告诉一位求职者，该公司价值数百万美元，并且公司的投资组合将在未来几个月内增长三倍。该求职者对公司的前景感到非常兴奋，并接受了在该公司工作的要约。两天后，该求职者在报纸上读到该投资公司已申请破产重组。由于读到这一消息，该求职者遭受了严重的情感困扰，但他立即找到了另一份相当的职位。

该求职者在针对过失性失实陈述的诉讼中是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the applicant did not suffer any physical injury or pecuniary loss.
否，因为求职者没有遭受任何身体伤害或金钱损失。

B. No, because the personnel director's statement was purely speculative.
否，因为人事总监的陈述纯属推测性的。

C. Yes, because the applicant relied on the personnel director's misrepresentations about the investment company.
是，因为求职者依赖了人事总监关于该投资公司的失实陈述。

D. Yes, because the personnel director should have foreseen that his misrepresentations would cause the applicant to be distressed.
是，因为人事总监应当预见到他的失实陈述会导致求职者感到困扰。
data.explanation:
Liability for negligent misrepresentation arises when:
  • the defendant negligently provides the plaintiff with false information in a commercial setting (eg, in the course of the defendant's business or profession) and the plaintiff reasonably relies on that information and suffers pecuniary loss (ie, monetary loss)
  • the defendant negligently provides the plaintiff with false information under circumstances posing a risk of physical harm and the plaintiff reasonably relies on that information and suffers physical harm.


Here, the personnel director may have negligently misrepresented the company's worth and prospects to the applicant. And the applicant may have reasonably relied on those misrepresentations by accepting an offer to work for the company (Choice C). But since the applicant immediately found a comparable position (no pecuniary loss) and faced no risk of - and did not suffer - physical harm, his claim will likely fail.

(Choice B) Reliance on purely speculative information is generally unreasonable. But since the personnel director's statement appeared to include factual information (eg, that the company was worth millions of dollars), the applicant's reliance may have been reasonable. Regardless, the applicant will not prevail because he did not suffer the requisite harm.

(Choice D) A victim of negligent misrepresentation can only recover damages for pecuniary loss or physical harm - not any foreseeable harm (eg, stand-alone emotional distress). Therefore, whether the personnel director should have foreseen that his misrepresentations would cause the applicant emotional distress is irrelevant.

Educational objective: Liability for negligent misrepresentation arises when a defendant negligently provides false information to a plaintiff who reasonably relies on that information (1) in a commercial setting and suffers pecuniary loss or (2) under circumstances posing a risk of physical harm and suffers physical harm.



选项正确率统计：A选项 60%（正确选项），B选项 16%，C选项 20%，D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

过失性失实陈述的责任在以下情况产生：
  • 被告在商业环境中（例如，在被告的业务或职业过程中）过失地向原告提供了虚假信息，并且原告合理地依赖了该信息并遭受了金钱损失（即货币损失）
  • 被告在构成身体伤害风险的情况下过失地向原告提供了虚假信息，并且原告合理地依赖了该信息并遭受了身体伤害。


在本案中，人事总监可能对公司的价值和前景向求职者作出了过失性失实陈述。并且求职者可能因接受公司的工作要约而合理地依赖了这些失实陈述（选项C）。但由于求职者立即找到了相当的职位（没有金钱损失），并且没有面临也未遭受身体伤害的风险，他的诉求很可能会失败。

（选项B）对纯属推测性信息的依赖通常是不合理的。但由于人事总监的陈述似乎包含了事实信息（例如，公司价值数百万美元），求职者的依赖可能是合理的。无论如何，由于求职者没有遭受必要的损害，他将无法胜诉。

（选项D）过失性失实陈述的受害者只能就金钱损失或身体伤害获得损害赔偿——而不是任何可预见的损害（例如，独立的情感困扰）。因此，人事总监是否应当预见到他的失实陈述会导致求职者情感困扰是无关紧要的。

教学目标：当被告向原告过失地提供了虚假信息，而原告合理地依赖该信息，并且（1）在商业环境中遭受了金钱损失，或者（2）在存在身体伤害风险的情况下遭受了身体伤害时，便会产生过失性失实陈述的责任。

References

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 552 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (negligent misrepresentation).

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 311 (Am. Law Inst. 1965) (negligent misrepresentation involving risk of physical harm).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

侵权法 (Torts) - 过失性失实陈述

正确答案：A
核心法律规则

过失性失实陈述 (Negligent Misrepresentation) 的成立通常需要满足以下要素：

  1. 被告在商业或职业活动中提供了虚假信息；
  2. 被告在获取或传达信息时存在过失；
  3. 原告合理地依赖 (Justifiable Reliance) 了该信息；
  4. 关键点：原告因此遭受了金钱损失 (Pecuniary Loss)。

参考来源：Restatement (Second) of Torts § 552

本案深度解析

本题考察的是侵权法中对于“损害” (Damages) 的具体要求。虽然人事总监提供了虚假信息（公司价值和前景），且求职者依赖该信息接受了工作，但该侵权行为的性质决定了其赔偿范围。

为什么选 A？

过失性失实陈述主要保护的是商业利益。法律规定，此类诉讼的原告必须证明遭受了实际的金钱损失 (Pecuniary Loss)。在本案中：

  • 求职者虽然感到“严重的情感困扰” (Severe emotional distress)，但这属于精神损害，通常不足以支持过失性失实陈述的索赔（除非伴随身体伤害，本案未涉及）。
  • 求职者“立即找到了另一份相当的职位” (Immediately found another comparable position)，这意味着他没有遭受工资损失或其他经济损失。

因此，由于缺乏必要的损害要素（金钱损失），原告无法胜诉。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 B (错误)：
虽然一般来说，对未来的预测或观点 (Opinion/Speculation) 不构成失实陈述，但如果陈述者拥有特殊知识或陈述包含事实成分（如“公司价值数百万”），则可能构成例外。然而，即使陈述不属于推测，原告败诉的根本原因仍然是没有损失，而不是陈述的性质。
选项 C (错误)：
“依赖” (Reliance) 确实是该侵权行为的一个要素，且本案中原告确实依赖了该陈述。但是，仅有依赖是不够的，侵权责任的成立必须同时具备损害结果。
选项 D (错误)：
这个选项试图混淆“过失性失实陈述”与“过失致人精神损害” (Negligent Infliction of Emotional Distress, NIED)。过失性失实陈述是一种经济侵权 (Economic Tort)，其目的不是保护人们免受情感困扰。因此，情感困扰是否可预见 (Foreseeable) 在此案中是不相关的。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip) 在处理侵权法题目时，务必区分侵权类型及其对应的损害要求：
  • 过失 (Negligence)：通常需要身体伤害 (Physical Harm) 或财产损失。
  • 过失性失实陈述 (Negligent Misrepresentation)：必须有金钱损失 (Pecuniary Loss)。
  • 故意致人精神损害 (IIED)：可以仅有严重精神痛苦。
如果题目中明确指出原告“立即找到了相当的工作”或“没有经济损失”，这通常是出题人在暗示你：损害要素缺失。

questions.question:
Upon the recommendation of her child's pediatrician, a mother purchased a vaporizer for her child, who had been suffering from respiratory congestion. The vaporizer consisted of a gallon-size glass jar, which held water to be heated until it became steam, and a metal heating unit into which the jar fit. The jar was covered by a plastic cap with an opening to allow the steam to escape. At the time the vaporizer was manufactured and sold, there was no safer alternative design.
The booklet that accompanied the vaporizer read: "This product is safe, spillproof, and practically foolproof. It shuts off automatically when the water is gone." The booklet had a picture of a vaporizer sending steam over a baby's crib.
The mother used the vaporizer whenever the child was suffering from congestion. She placed the vaporizer on the floor near the child's bed.
One night, the child got out of bed to get a drink of water and tripped over the cord of the vaporizer as she crossed the room. The top of the vaporizer separated from the base, and boiling water from the jar spilled on the child when the vaporizer tipped over. The child suffered serious burns as a consequence.
The child's representative brought an action for damages against the manufacturer of the vaporizer. The manufacturer moved to dismiss after the representative presented the evidence above.
Should the manufacturer's motion be granted?

choices.a: No, because a jury could find that the manufacturer expressly represented that the vaporizer was spillproof.
choices.b: No, because the vaporizer caused a serious injury to the child.
choices.c: Yes, because it should have been obvious to the mother that the water in the jar would become boiling hot.
choices.d: Yes, because there was no safer alternative design.

data.questionStem:
Q83192

Upon the recommendation of her child's pediatrician, a mother purchased a vaporizer for her child, who had been suffering from respiratory congestion. The vaporizer consisted of a gallon-size glass jar, which held water to be heated until it became steam, and a metal heating unit into which the jar fit. The jar was covered by a plastic cap with an opening to allow the steam to escape. At the time the vaporizer was manufactured and sold, there was no safer alternative design.

The booklet that accompanied the vaporizer read: "This product is safe, spillproof, and practically foolproof. It shuts off automatically when the water is gone." The booklet had a picture of a vaporizer sending steam over a baby's crib.

The mother used the vaporizer whenever the child was suffering from congestion. She placed the vaporizer on the floor near the child's bed.

One night, the child got out of bed to get a drink of water and tripped over the cord of the vaporizer as she crossed the room. The top of the vaporizer separated from the base, and boiling water from the jar spilled on the child when the vaporizer tipped over. The child suffered serious burns as a consequence.

The child's representative brought an action for damages against the manufacturer of the vaporizer. The manufacturer moved to dismiss after the representative presented the evidence above.

Should the manufacturer's motion be granted?

经其儿科医生的推荐，一位母亲为她患有呼吸道充血的孩子购买了一台蒸发器。该蒸发器由一个一加仑大小的玻璃罐和一个与之配套的金属加热装置组成，玻璃罐中的水被加热后会变成蒸汽。罐子被一个塑料盖盖住，盖子上有一个开口让蒸汽逸出。在该蒸发器制造和销售之时，没有更安全的替代设计。

蒸发器附带的说明书写道：“本产品安全、防溢出，且几乎是万无一失的。水量耗尽后会自动关闭。”说明书上还有一张蒸发器向婴儿床输送蒸汽的图片。

每当孩子出现充血症状时，这位母亲就使用该蒸发器。她将蒸发器放在孩子床边的地板上。

一天晚上，孩子下床去喝水，穿过房间时被蒸发器的电线绊倒。蒸发器翻倒时，其顶部与底座分离，罐中的沸水洒在了孩子身上。孩子因此受到严重烧伤。

孩子的代理人对该蒸发器的制造商提起了损害赔偿之诉。在代理人出示了上述证据后，制造商提出了驳回起诉的动议。

制造商的动议应否被批准？
options:
A. No, because a jury could find that the manufacturer expressly represented that the vaporizer was spillproof.
不应批准，因为陪审团可以认定制造商明确陈述了该蒸发器是防溢出的。

B. No, because the vaporizer caused a serious injury to the child.
不应批准，因为蒸发器对孩子造成了严重伤害。

C. Yes, because it should have been obvious to the mother that the water in the jar would become boiling hot.
应批准，因为母亲理应清楚地知道罐子里的水会变成沸水。

D. Yes, because there was no safer alternative design.
应批准，因为没有更安全的替代设计。
data.explanation:
A court should grant a defendant's motion to dismiss if the plaintiff fails to present legally sufficient evidence to support every element of his/her claim (ie, no reasonable jury could find in the plaintiff's favor). Therefore, a court should grant a motion to dismiss a products liability action based on misrepresentation if there is insufficient evidence to support any of the following elements:

  • The defendant (a commercial seller ) made a misrepresentation of material fact about a product to the public.
  • A consumer (not necessarily the plaintiff) justifiably relied on this misrepresentation when purchasing that product.
  • That product caused the plaintiff harm.


Here, the manufacturer sold the vaporizer with a booklet that expressly stated that the vaporizer was spillproof and included a picture that implied that the vaporizer could be safely used beside a child's crib (misrepresentation). Because a reasonable jury could conclude that the mother justifiably relied on these assertions when she purchased the vaporizer and that the vaporizer caused her child harm, the manufacturer's motion to dismiss should be denied.

(Choice B) The fact that the vaporizer seriously injured the child provides evidence of harm. However, the child cannot recover for that harm unless there also is evidence that the manufacturer falsely represented that the vaporizer was spillproof. Since there is such evidence, the court should deny the manufacturer's motion.

(Choice C) While it should have been obvious to the mother that the water in the vaporizer would become extremely hot, it was still reasonable for her to rely on the manufacturer's assertion that the product was spillproof.

(Choice D) Even if a reasonable jury could find that the manufacturer did not defectively design the vaporizer because there was no safer alternative design, the manufacturer may still be liable for misrepresenting the vaporizer's safety.

Educational objective: Products liability based on misrepresentation arises when
  • the defendant (a commercial supplier) misrepresents a material fact about a product,
  • a consumer justifiably relied on that misrepresentation, and
  • the product caused the plaintiff harm.




选项正确率统计：A选项 78%（正确选项），B选项 8%，C选项 3%，D选项 9%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

如果原告未能提供法律上充分的证据来支持其主张的每一个要素（即，没有一个理性的陪审团会做出有利于原告的裁决），法院应批准被告驳回起诉的动议。因此，如果证据不足以支持以下任何一个要素，法院应批准驳回一项基于虚假陈述的products liability（产品责任）之诉：

  • 被告（商业销售者）就某一产品向公众作出了重大事实的虚假陈述。
  • 消费者（不必然是原告）在购买该产品时正当地信赖了这一虚假陈述。
  • 该产品对原告造成了伤害。


在本案中，制造商销售的蒸发器附带的说明书明确说明该蒸发器是防溢出的，并包含一张图片暗示蒸发器可以安全地在孩子的婴儿床旁使用（虚假陈述）。由于一个理性的陪审团可以得出结论，即母亲在购买蒸发器时正当地信赖了这些说法，且蒸发器对其孩子造成了伤害，因此制造商的驳回动议应被驳回。

（选项B）蒸发器严重伤害了孩子这一事实提供了伤害的证据。然而，除非同时有证据表明制造商虚假地陈述了蒸发器是防溢出的，否则孩子不能就该伤害获得赔偿。由于存在此类证据，法院应驳回制造商的动议。

（选项C）尽管母亲理应清楚地知道蒸发器中的水会变得极热，但她信赖制造商关于产品是防溢出的说法仍然是合理的。

（选项D）即使一个理性的陪审团可以认定，由于没有更安全的替代设计，制造商并未在设计上存在缺陷，但制造商仍可能要因虚假陈述蒸发器的安全性而承担责任。

教学目标：基于虚假陈述的产品责任在以下情况产生：
  • 被告（商业供应者）就产品的重大事实作出了虚假陈述，
  • 消费者正当地信赖了该虚假陈述，且
  • 该产品对原告造成了伤害。


References

  • Restatement (Third) ofTorts:Prods Liab § 9 (Am LawInst 1998) (products liabilitybymisrepresentation)
  • Restatement (Third) of Torts: Prods. Liab. § 9 (Am. Law Inst. 1998) (products liability by misrepresentation).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 402B (Am. Law Inst. 1965) (strict products liability by misrepresentation).

MBE 考点解析

Torts: Products Liability (Misrepresentation)

核心法律规则

本题考查的是基于虚假陈述 (Misrepresentation) 的产品责任。

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 402B:
如果商业销售者通过广告、标签或其他方式向公众对产品的性质或质量做出了重大事实的虚假陈述 (Misrepresentation of Material Fact)，且消费者因正当信赖 (Justifiable Reliance) 该陈述而遭受物理伤害，则销售者需承担严格责任。

注意：即使该陈述并非欺诈性或过失性的，且产品本身没有设计缺陷，该责任依然成立。

正确答案：A

"No, because a jury could find that the manufacturer expressly represented that the vaporizer was spillproof."

解析逻辑：

  • 陈述 (Representation): 制造商在说明书中明确写道产品是 "spillproof"（防溢出）且 "safe"（安全）。
  • 事实不符 (Falsity): 事实证明，当蒸发器翻倒时，沸水洒出并烫伤了孩子，说明它并非 "spillproof"。
  • 信赖 (Reliance): 母亲阅读了说明书并购买使用，陪审团可以合理推断她信赖了这一安全承诺。
  • 结论: 既然存在明确的虚假陈述导致伤害，无论产品设计是否尽力，制造商都不能免责。因此，法院不应批准驳回起诉的动议。
常见陷阱：选项 D

"Yes, because there was no safer alternative design."

为什么这是错的？
这是 MBE 中非常经典的干扰项。

  • 设计缺陷 vs. 虚假陈述： "没有更安全的替代设计" (No safer alternative design) 是针对 设计缺陷 (Design Defect) 诉讼的有力抗辩。
  • 本案特殊性： 即使产品代表了当时的最高科技水平（State of the Art），如果制造商吹嘘了它实际上达不到的安全性能（如承诺“防溢出”却做不到），制造商仍需对该虚假陈述负责。
  • 考点： 你不能承诺你的产品做不到的事情，哪怕那个事情在当时的技术下确实做不到。
其他选项分析
  • 选项 B (错误): 仅因为产品造成伤害并不足以让制造商承担责任。产品责任通常要求证明存在缺陷（Defect）或虚假陈述。严格责任 (Strict Liability) 不是绝对责任 (Absolute Liability)。
  • 选项 C (错误): 虽然沸水烫人是常识，但母亲依赖制造商关于“防溢出”的特别承诺是合理的 (Justifiable Reliance)。该承诺实际上是在说：“虽然里面有沸水，但我们的特殊设计能防止它洒出来。”
💡 MBE 备考贴士

当题目中出现具体的标签 (Label)、说明书 (Booklet) 或 广告语 时，请立即警惕 Express Warranty 或 Misrepresentation 考点。

在这种情况下，通常不需要证明产品存在“设计缺陷”或“制造缺陷”，只要证明产品未能达到其承诺的性能即可。

A retired couple had lived in their home in a residential neighborhood for 20 years when a large family moved into the house next door and built a swimming pool in the backyard. The family's four young children frequently played in the pool after school. They often were joined by other neighborhood children. The retired couple was in the habit of reading and listening to classical music in the afternoons. Sometimes the couple took naps. The boisterous sounds of the children playing in the pool disturbed the couple's customary enjoyment of quiet afternoons.
In a nuisance action for damages against the family, is the couple likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the children's interest in healthy play has priority over the couple's interest in peace and quiet.
choices.b: No, unless the noise constituted a substantial and unreasonable disturbance to persons of normal sensibilities.
choices.c: Yes, because the couple's interest in the quiet enjoyment of their home takes precedence in time over the family's interests.
choices.d: Yes, if the children's noise constituted a substantial interference with the couple's use and enjoyment of their home.

data.questionStem:
Q83174

A retired couple had lived in their home in a residential neighborhood for 20 years when a large family moved into the house next door and built a swimming pool in the backyard. The family's four young children frequently played in the pool after school. They often were joined by other neighborhood children. The retired couple was in the habit of reading and listening to classical music in the afternoons. Sometimes the couple took naps. The boisterous sounds of the children playing in the pool disturbed the couple's customary enjoyment of quiet afternoons.

In a nuisance action for damages against the family, is the couple likely to prevail?

一对退休夫妇在一个住宅区居住了20年，这时一个大家庭搬进了隔壁的房子，并在后院建了一个游泳池。这家的四个年幼孩子放学后经常在游泳池里玩耍。他们经常和其他邻居的孩子一起玩。这对退休夫妇习惯于在下午读书和听古典音乐。有时这对夫妇会午睡。孩子们在游泳池里玩耍的喧闹声打扰了这对夫妇惯常享受的宁静下午。

在一场针对该家庭提起的、要求损害赔偿的妨害行为诉讼中，这对夫妇有可能胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because the children's interest in healthy play has priority over the couple's interest in peace and quiet.
不会，因为孩子们健康玩耍的利益优先于这对夫妇对和平与安宁的利益。

B. No, unless the noise constituted a substantial and unreasonable disturbance to persons of normal sensibilities.
不会，除非该噪音对具有正常感受力的人构成了实质性且不合理的干扰。

C. Yes, because the couple's interest in the quiet enjoyment of their home takes precedence in time over the family's interests.
会，因为这对夫妇对其住宅的宁静享用权的利益在时间上优先于该家庭的利益。

D. Yes, if the children's noise constituted a substantial interference with the couple's use and enjoyment of their home.
会，如果孩子们的噪音对这对夫妇对其住宅的使用和享用构成了实质性干涉。
data.explanation:
A plaintiff can sue for private nuisance when a person interferes with the plaintiff's use and enjoyment of his/her property. To prevail in that suit, the plaintiff must show that the interference was both:

  • substantial - offensive, annoying, or intolerable to a normal person in the community
  • unreasonable - the severity of the plaintiff's harm outweighed the utility of the defendant's conduct.


An interference is not substantial if the plaintiff's unusual sensitivity causes him/her to regard the interference as offensive, annoying, or intolerable when a person with normal sensibilities would not.

Here, the boisterous sounds of the family's children playing next door interfered with the couple's enjoyment of quiet afternoons at home. But the couple will not prevail on their nuisance claim unless that interference was both substantial (eg, residents with normal sensibilities would be annoyed) and unreasonable (ie, the severity of the couple's harm outweighs the utility of the children's conduct) (Choice D).

(Choice A) The children's interest in healthy play (utility) does not necessarily have priority over the couple's interest in peace and quiet (harm) since courts weigh multiple factors to determine whether an interference was unreasonable. And even if the interference was unreasonable, the couple will prevail only if the interference was also substantial.

(Choice C) Courts may consider precedence in time (ie, whether the plaintiff came to the nuisance) when determining if a nuisance is actionable. Therefore, the fact that the couple's interest in the quiet enjoyment of their home takes precedence in time over the family's interests helps show that the couple's claim is actionable. But they will only prevail if the children's interference was substantial and unreasonable.

Educational objective: An interference with the plaintiff's use and enjoyment of his/her property is not substantial - and will not support a private nuisance claim - unless a person with normal sensibilities would regard the interference as offensive, annoying, or intolerable.



选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 81%（正确选项），C选项 0%，D选项 17%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当一个人的行为干涉了原告对其财产的使用和享用时，原告可以就 private nuisance 提起诉讼。为了在该诉讼中胜诉，原告必须证明该干涉同时是：

  • 实质性的 - 对于社区中的正常人而言是冒犯性的、令人烦恼的或无法忍受的
  • 不合理的 - 原告所受损害的严重性超过了被告行为的功用。


如果原告的异于常人的敏感性导致其认为该干涉是冒犯性的、令人烦恼的或无法忍受的，而一个具有正常感受力的人并不会如此认为，则该干涉是非实质性的。

在本案中，隔壁家庭的孩子们玩耍的喧闹声干涉了这对夫妇在家享受宁静下午的权利。但这对夫妇的妨害行为主张将不会胜诉，除非该干涉既是实质性的（例如，具有正常感受力的居民会感到烦恼）并且是不合理的（即，这对夫妇所受损害的严重性超过了孩子们行为的功用）（选项D）。

（选项A） 孩子们健康玩耍的利益（功用）并不必然优先于这对夫妇对和平与安宁的利益（损害），因为法院在确定一项干涉是否不合理时会权衡多种因素。并且，即使该干涉是不合理的，这对夫妇也只有在该干涉同时是实质性的情况下才能胜诉。

（选项C） 法院在确定一项妨害行为是否可诉时，可能会考虑时间上的优先性（即，原告是否是后于妨害行为而至）。因此，这对夫妇对其住宅的宁静享用权的利益在时间上优先于该家庭的利益这一事实，有助于表明这对夫妇的主张是可诉的。但他们只有在孩子们的干涉是实质性且不合理的情况下才能胜诉。

教学目标：对原告财产使用和享用权的干涉，除非一个具有正常感受力的人会认为该干涉是冒犯性的、令人烦恼的或无法忍受的，否则该干涉就不是实质性的，因而也不足以支持一项 private nuisance 主张。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Torts §§ 821D, 822 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (private nuisance).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 821F (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (substantial harm requirement).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 826 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (unreasonable interference requirement).
