MBE 考点解析

侵权法 (Torts) - 私人妨害 (Private Nuisance)

核心考点：私人妨害的构成要件

本题考查的是私人妨害 (Private Nuisance) 中的关键抗辩理由：原告的超敏反应或异常使用。

基本规则：
私人妨害是指对原告使用和享有其土地造成了实质性 (Substantial) 且 不合理 (Unreasonable) 的干扰。

如何判断“实质性”？
必须采用客观标准 (Objective Standard)。干扰必须是对社区中普通人 (Average Person) 而言是冒犯的、烦恼的或无法忍受的。

⚠️ 陷阱：超敏原告 (Hypersensitive Plaintiff)

如果原告的损害仅仅是因为其对土地进行了异常使用 (Abnormal Use) 或自身具有超敏反应 (Hypersensitivity)，而这种干扰不会影响到一个普通人，那么这种干扰不构成实质性干扰。

本题应用：
  • 原告使用的是“精密电子设备” (Sensitive electronic equipment)。
  • 这是对土地的“异常使用” (Abnormal use)。
  • 如果没有这些精密设备，普通人可能根本感觉不到高压电的干扰。

因此，除非原告能证明该干扰严重到连普通业务或普通人都会受到影响，否则他无法胜诉。

选项解析
正确答案 B 逻辑推演：
选项 B 指出：“不会胜诉，除非公司造成了实质性且不合理的干扰。”
这正是法律规则的体现。原告必须克服“超敏反应”的抗辩，证明该干扰在客观上是实质性的（即也会影响非敏感设备或普通人）。如果仅仅因为设备敏感而受损，不满足妨害的构成要件。
错误选项 C 关于异常危险活动 (Abnormally Dangerous Activity)：
虽然高压电可能被视为异常危险活动，但严格责任 (Strict Liability) 仅限于该活动特有的风险 (Risk that makes it dangerous)。

Foster v. Preston Mill Co. 原则： 高压电的特有风险是触电、火灾或爆炸，而不是“电磁干扰”。因此，不能适用严格责任。
错误选项 A 关于经济损失：
在过失侵权 (Negligence) 中通常不能仅追偿纯粹经济损失，但在妨害 (Nuisance) 中，只要证明了对土地使用权的干扰，是可以追偿相关的经济损失的。
🎓 MBE 备考技巧：

看到“敏感设备”、“狗听到高频噪音”、“水貂听到噪音吞食幼崽”等情节时，立即联想 Hypersensitivity (超敏反应)。

记住口诀：Nuisance protects the ordinary person, not the delicate one. (妨害法保护普通人，不保护娇气的人)。

questions.question:
A cigarette maker created and published a magazine advertisement that featured a person dressed as a race-car driver with a helmet on standing in front of a distinctive race car. In fact, the car looked almost exactly like the very unusually marked car driven by a famous and popular driver. The driver in the ad was not identified, and his face was not shown. The cigarette maker published the advertisement without obtaining the famous driver's permission.
The famous race-car driver sued the cigarette maker for economic loss only, based on common law misappropriation of the right of publicity. The cigarette maker moved to dismiss the complaint.
Will the cigarette maker's motion to dismiss the complaint be granted?

choices.a: No, because there are sufficient indicia of the famous driver's identity to support a verdict of liability.
choices.b: Yes, because the driver is a public figure.
choices.c: Yes, because the famous driver did not claim any emotional or dignitary loss.
choices.d: Yes, because there was no mention of the famous driver's name in the ad.

data.questionStem:
Q83157

A cigarette maker created and published a magazine advertisement that featured a person dressed as a race-car driver with a helmet on standing in front of a distinctive race car. In fact, the car looked almost exactly like the very unusually marked car driven by a famous and popular driver. The driver in the ad was not identified, and his face was not shown. The cigarette maker published the advertisement without obtaining the famous driver's permission.

The famous race-car driver sued the cigarette maker for economic loss only, based on common law misappropriation of the right of publicity. The cigarette maker moved to dismiss the complaint.

Will the cigarette maker's motion to dismiss the complaint be granted?

一家香烟制造商制作并发布了一则杂志广告，广告中一个头戴头盔、身着赛车手服饰的人站在一辆独特的赛车前。事实上，这辆车看起来与一位著名且广受欢迎的赛车手所驾驶的、标志非常独特的赛车几乎一模一样。广告中的车手身份未被指明，其面部也未显示。该香烟制造商在未获得这位著名车手许可的情况下发布了该广告。

这位著名赛车手以普通法上的“盗用公开权” (common law misappropriation of the right of publicity) 为由，仅就经济损失起诉该香烟制造商。香烟制造商请求驳回起诉。

香烟制造商请求驳回起诉的动议会否被批准？
options:
A. No, because there are sufficient indicia of the famous driver's identity to support a verdict of liability.
不会，因为存在足以表明该著名车手身份的充分标志，可支持作出其应承担责任的判决。

B. Yes, because the driver is a public figure.
会，因为该车手是公众人物。

C. Yes, because the famous driver did not claim any emotional or dignitary loss.
会，因为这位著名车手没有主张任何精神或人格尊严上的损失。

D. Yes, because there was no mention of the famous driver's name in the ad.
会，因为广告中没有提及这位著名车手的名字。
data.explanation:
A defendant's motion to dismiss will be granted if the plaintiff's complaint fails to allege facts sufficient to support his/her claim. For a misappropriation of the right to publicity (ie, appropriation of name or likeness) claim, the plaintiff must allege that the defendant:
  • used the plaintiff's identity (ie, name, likeness, or item closely associated with the plaintiff ) without authorization
  • to receive a benefit (typically for a commercial purpose - eg, using the plaintiff's picture to advertise a product).

Here, though the cigarette maker did not use the famous driver's name or picture, it did feature a distinctive race car that was almost identical to his unusually marked car (item closely associated with the driver) in its advertisement (commercial purpose). Therefore, that advertisement contained sufficient indicia of the driver's identity to support his complaint and the court will likely deny the cigarette maker's motion to dismiss.

(Choice B) Public figures (persons who achieve pervasive fame/notoriety or who voluntarily involve themselves in a public controversy) have the same right to control the use of their identity as everyone else. Therefore, the driver's status as a public figure will not prevent him from recovering for misappropriation of his right to publicity.

(Choice C) Misappropriation of the right to publicity allows the plaintiff to recover for emotional distress or personal humiliation, but neither is required. Therefore, the driver's complaint did not need to allege any emotional or dignitary loss.

(Choice D) Although the cigarette maker's ad did not mention the famous driver by name, its use of his unusually marked race car was sufficient to depict or identify him.

Educational objective: Misappropriation of the right to publicity is the unauthorized use of the plaintiff's identity - ie, name, likeness, or item closely associated with the plaintiff - for the defendant's benefit (typically for a commercial purpose).



选项正确率统计：A选项 89%（正确选项），B选项 1%，C选项 5%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

如果原告的诉状未能陈述足以支持其主张的事实，则被告的驳回动议 (motion to dismiss) 将被批准。对于盗用公开权 (misappropriation of the right to publicity)（即盗用姓名或肖像）的诉讼主张，原告必须指称被告：
  • 未经授权使用了原告的身份标识（即姓名、肖像或与原告密切相关的物品）
  • 以获取利益（通常是出于商业目的——例如，使用原告的照片为产品做广告）。

在本案中，尽管香烟制造商没有使用这位著名车手的姓名或照片，但它在其广告（商业目的）中展示了一辆与他那辆标志独特的赛车（与车手密切相关的物品）几乎一模一样的独特赛车。因此，该广告包含了足以表明车手身份的充分标志，可以支持其诉讼主张，法院很可能会驳回香烟制造商的动议。

(选项 B) 公众人物（指获得广泛声誉/恶名或自愿卷入公共争议的人）与其他人一样，有权控制其身份标识的使用。因此，该车手的公众人物身份不会妨碍其就公开权被盗用获得赔偿。

(选项 C) 盗用公开权允许原告就精神痛苦或个人屈辱获得赔偿，但这两者都不是必需的。因此，该车手的诉状无需主张任何精神或人格尊严上的损失。

(选项 D) 尽管香烟制造商的广告没有指名道姓地提及这位著名车手，但使用他那辆标志独特的赛车已足以描绘或识别出他。

教学目的：盗用公开权 (Misappropriation of the right to publicity) 是指未经授权使用原告的身份标识——即姓名、肖像或与原告密切相关的物品——为被告谋取利益（通常是出于商业目的）。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 652C (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (appropriation of name or likeness).
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 12(b)(6) (motion to dismiss).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

侵权法：公开权的盗用
正确答案：A

不会被驳回。因为广告中包含了足以识别该著名车手身份的特征（即那辆独特的赛车），这足以支持责任判决。

⚖️ 核心考点：盗用公开权
🆔

Misappropriation of Right of Publicity
（盗用公开权/形象权）

这是侵犯隐私权（Invasion of Privacy）的四种侵权行为之一。构成要件如下：

  1. 被告未经授权使用了原告的身份标识 (Identity)；
  2. 为了被告的商业利益 (Commercial Advantage)。

注意：这里的“身份标识”不局限于姓名或肖像，还包括任何能够让人联想到原告的独特物品或特征。

📚 经典判例 (Case Law)

Motschenbacher v. R. J. Reynolds Tobacco Co. (1974)

本题几乎完全复刻了这个著名的第九巡回上诉法院判例。

在该案中，烟草公司在广告中使用了一辆经过改装的独特赛车图片。虽然驾驶员的面部不可见，但因为该赛车的涂装极其独特（distinctive markings），公众看到车就会联想到该赛车手。

法院裁定：即使没有使用名字或脸，“独特的赛车” (Distinctive Race Car) 构成了车手身份的象征，因此构成了对公开权的侵犯。

🚫 陷阱排除
选项 B 错误 (Public Figure)：
公众人物不仅拥有公开权，而且他们的形象通常具有更高的商业价值。公众人物身份并不意味着商家可以免费盗用其形象牟利。
选项 C 错误 (Emotional Loss)：
与其他隐私侵权（如侵扰安宁 Intrusion）不同，公开权 (Right of Publicity) 本质上是一种财产权利 (Property Right)。原告只需证明经济损失（Economic Loss）即可，无需证明精神痛苦。
选项 D 错误 (No Name)：
这是最常见的干扰项。法律不要求必须使用“姓名”。只要使用了“身份的充分标志” (Sufficient Indicia of Identity)——如声音模仿、独特的服装或本题中的独特赛车——即构成侵权。
💡 考试通关秘籍

在处理 MBE 侵权法题目时，如果遇到“名人 + 广告 + 未经许可”的组合：

  • 首先判断是否涉及商业利益（通常是广告）。
  • 其次寻找连接点：广告中的元素（声音、背影、物品）是否能让公众立即联想到该名人？
  • 如果是，即便没有露脸或提名字，原告通常也能胜诉。
  • Motion to Dismiss 标准： 只要原告的诉状中指称的事实（如“车很独特”）如果被证实为真，能够满足法律要件，法院就不会驳回起诉。

questions.question:
For ten years, a woman and her neighbor have owned summer vacation homes on adjoining lots. A stream flows through both lots. As a result of a childhood swimming accident, the woman is afraid of water and has never gone close to the stream.
The neighbor built a dam on his property that has completely stopped the flow of the stream to the woman's property.
In a suit by the woman against the neighbor, will the woman prevail?

choices.a: No, because the woman made no use of the stream.
choices.b: No, if the dam was built in conformity with all applicable laws.
choices.c: Yes, if the damming unreasonably interferes with the use and enjoyment of the woman's property.
choices.d: Yes, if the neighbor intended to affect the woman's property.

data.questionStem:
Q83194

For ten years, a woman and her neighbor have owned summer vacation homes on adjoining lots. A stream flows through both lots. As a result of a childhood swimming accident, the woman is afraid of water and has never gone close to the stream.

The neighbor built a dam on his property that has completely stopped the flow of the stream to the woman's property.

In a suit by the woman against the neighbor, will the woman prevail?

十年来，一名女子和她的邻居在相邻地块上拥有避暑别墅。一条小溪流经两人的地块。由于童年时的一次游泳事故，该女子怕水，从未靠近过小溪。

邻居在其地产上修建了一座水坝，完全阻断了流向该女子地产的溪流。

在该女子对邻居提起的诉讼中，该女子会胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because the woman made no use of the stream.
不会，因为该女子并未使用该溪流。

B. No, if the dam was built in conformity with all applicable laws.
不会，如果水坝的建造符合所有适用法律。

C. Yes, if the damming unreasonably interferes with the use and enjoyment of the woman's property.
会，如果筑坝不合理地干涉了该女子对其地产的使用和享用。

D. Yes, if the neighbor intended to affect the woman's property.
会，如果邻居意图影响该女子的地产。
data.explanation:
Liability for private nuisance arises when a defendant's interference with the use and enjoyment of the plaintiff's property is both:

  • substantial - offensive, annoying, or intolerable to a normal person in the community and
  • unreasonable - the severity of the plaintiff's harm outweighs the utility of the defendant's conduct.


Therefore, a plaintiff who is not bothered by an interference with the use and enjoyment of his/her property can still prevail as long as a normal person in the community would find the interference offensive, annoying, or intolerable (ie, the interference is still substantial).

Here, the neighbor's dam interfered with the use and enjoyment of the woman's property by stopping the flow of a stream to her property. Although the woman was afraid of water and made no use of the stream, the interference was still substantial since a normal person in her community of summer vacation homes would likely be annoyed by the damming of the stream (Choice A). Therefore, the woman will prevail if the interference was also unreasonable.

(Choice B) Although a defendant's compliance with the law is a factor that weighs in favor of a finding that an interference was not unreasonable, compliance with the law is not a complete defense to private nuisance. Therefore, though the dam's conformity with applicable laws weighs in the neighbor's favor, it does not - by itself - defeat the woman's claim.

(Choice D) Private nuisance requires proof that the defendant's conduct was tortious - but not necessarily intentional. So even if the neighbor did not intend to affect the woman's property, the woman could still prevail if the neighbor's conduct was negligent, reckless, or abnormally dangerous.

Educational objective: Private nuisance is a substantial and unreasonable interference with the use and enjoyment of the plaintiff's property. An interference is substantial if a normal person in the community would find the interference offensive, annoying, or intolerable - even if the plaintiff is not personally bothered by it.



选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 2%，C选项 85%（正确选项），D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当被告对原告地产的使用和享用的干涉同时满足以下两点时，private nuisance（私人妨害）的法律责任即产生：

  • 实质性的 (substantial)——对于社区中的一个正常人而言是冒犯性的、恼人的或不可容忍的，并且
  • 不合理的 (unreasonable)——原告所受损害的严重性超过了被告行为的功用。


因此，即使原告本人未因其地产的使用和享用受到干涉而感到困扰，但只要社区中的一个正常人会认为该干涉是冒犯性的、恼人的或不可容忍的（即该干涉仍是实质性的），原告仍然可以胜诉。

在本案中，邻居的水坝阻断了流向该女子地产的溪流，从而干涉了她对地产的使用和享用。尽管该女子怕水且并未使用溪流，但这种干涉仍然是实质性的 (substantial)，因为在其避暑别墅社区中，一个正常人很可能会对溪流被筑坝阻断感到恼怒（选项 A）。因此，如果该干涉同时也是不合理的 (unreasonable)，那么该女子将会胜诉。

（选项 B）尽管被告遵守法律是支持干涉并非不合理的一个因素，但遵守法律并不能构成对 private nuisance 的完全抗辩。因此，尽管水坝符合适用法律这一点对邻居有利，但其本身并不能使该女子的诉求不成立。

（选项 D）Private nuisance 要求证明被告的行为是侵权行为——但不一定是故意的。因此，即使邻居无意影响该女子的地产，但如果邻居的行为是过失的 (negligent)、鲁莽的 (reckless) 或异常危险的 (abnormally dangerous)，该女子仍可能胜诉。

教学目标：Private nuisance 是对原告地产的使用和享用的实质性且不合理的干涉。如果社区中的一个正常人会认为该干涉是冒犯性的、恼人的或不可容忍的，那么该干涉就是实质性的——即使原告本人并未因此感到困扰。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Torts §§ 821D, 822 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (private nuisance).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 821F (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (substantial interference requirement).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 826 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (unreasonable interference requirement).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Torts: Private Nuisance & Water Rights
✅ 正确答案：C "Yes, if the damming unreasonably interferes with the use and enjoyment of the woman's property."
（会，如果筑坝不合理地干涉了该女子对其地产的使用和享用。）
核心法律规则：私人妨害

本题考查的是 Private Nuisance（私人妨害）的构成要件。在涉及邻里土地纠纷（尤其是水流阻断）时，这是最常见的诉因。

原告要胜诉，必须证明被告的行为导致了对原告土地 Use and Enjoyment（使用和享用）的干涉，且该干涉必须同时满足以下两个条件：

1️⃣ Substantial（实质性的）：
这是一个客观标准 (Objective Test)。即：该干扰是否会让社区里的一个正常人 (Normal Person) 感到冒犯、恼火或无法忍受？
2️⃣ Unreasonable（不合理的）：
这是一个平衡测试 (Balancing Test)。即：原告所受伤害的严重程度是否超过了被告行为的效用 (Utility)？
本案难点分析

本题设置了一个典型的“陷阱”：原告的特殊敏感性（或不敏感性）。

陷阱：原告怕水，从不使用溪流。被告可能会辩解说：“反正你也不用，我把水截断了对你没损失。”

破解逻辑：

  • 客观标准优先： 虽然原告本人不使用溪流，但对于一个拥有避暑别墅 (Summer Vacation Home) 的正常人来说，溪流完全断流会严重降低房产价值和居住体验。因此，这种干涉在法律上被视为 Substantial (实质性的)。
  • 权利本质： 土地所有权包含“使用和享用”的权利，这是一种潜在的权利，不完全取决于当前的具体用途。
  • 胜诉关键： 既然实质性已经满足（基于客观标准），剩下的关键就是看这种干涉是否 Unreasonable (不合理)。这就是选项 C 正确的原因。
为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ 选项 A (No use of stream): 错误。 Private Nuisance 采用客观标准。只要干扰对正常人是实质性的，原告目前的“不使用”并不能免除被告的责任。此外，根据河岸权 (Riparian Rights)，下游业主有权享有合理的水流，无论其当前是否积极利用。
❌ 选项 B (Conformity with laws): 错误。 合法不代表无侵权责任。遵守分区法或行政法规 (Zoning/Regulations) 是衡量行为是否“合理”的证据之一，但不是绝对抗辩 (Complete Defense)。如果造成的滋扰太大，即使合法施工也需赔偿。
❌ 选项 D (Intent): 错误。 Private Nuisance 不要求被告有“伤害原告的意图”。它只需要被告有意做出了导致妨害的行为（即有意修坝），或者行为是过失的、鲁莽的。被告修坝是故意的，这就足够满足意图要件了，不需要证明他“想害邻居”。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
在 Nuisance 题目中，如果看到原告有“特殊体质”（特别敏感或特别不敏感），请立即想到“Normal Person Standard”（正常人标准）。不要被原告的主观感受带偏。

questions.question:
A toy collector attended a flea market at which a variety of second-hand goods were sold. A seller who specialized in dolls also displayed a mechanical bank for sale at a price of $50. Although the collector had no knowledge of the seller, the collector was an expert in such banks and knew that this particular bank was actually worth $10,000. He paid the seller her asking price without any discussion regarding the bank or its value.
If the seller, upon learning of the bank's true value, asserts a tort claim against the collector based on fraud, will the seller be likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because fraud requires an active misrepresentation.
choices.b: No, because the collector had no duty to disclose the worth of the bank to the seller.
choices.c: Yes, because the bank's true value was 200 times the price paid by the collector.
choices.d: Yes, because the collector was aware of the seller's mistake.

Q83152

A toy collector attended a flea market at which a variety of second-hand goods were sold. A seller who specialized in dolls also displayed a mechanical bank for sale at a price of $50. Although the collector had no knowledge of the seller, the collector was an expert in such banks and knew that this particular bank was actually worth $10,000. He paid the seller her asking price without any discussion regarding the bank or its value.

If the seller, upon learning of the bank's true value, asserts a tort claim against the collector based on fraud, will the seller be likely to prevail?

一名玩具收藏家去了一个跳蚤市场，那里出售各种二手商品。一位专卖洋娃娃的卖家也展示了一个机械储蓄罐，售价50美元。虽然收藏家不认识这位卖家，但他本人是此类储蓄罐的专家，并且知道这个特定的储蓄罐实际价值10,000美元。他按卖家的要价付了款，并未就该储蓄罐或其价值进行任何讨论。

如果卖家在得知该储蓄罐的真实价值后，以欺诈为由对收藏家提起侵权索赔，卖家是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because fraud requires an active misrepresentation.
不会，因为欺诈需要主动的虚假陈述。

B. No, because the collector had no duty to disclose the worth of the bank to the seller.
不会，因为收藏家没有义务向卖家披露该储蓄罐的价值。

C. Yes, because the bank's true value was 200 times the price paid by the collector.
会，因为该储蓄罐的真实价值是收藏家支付价格的200倍。

D. Yes, because the collector was aware of the seller's mistake.
会，因为收藏家知晓卖家的错误。
data.explanation:
Fraud (ie, intentional misrepresentation) can occur when a defendant actively misrepresents or conceals a material fact. It can also occur when a defendant fails to disclose a material fact - but only if the defendant had a duty to disclose it. There is an affirmative duty to disclose a material fact in three limited circumstances:
  • The plaintiff has a fiduciary relationship with the defendant.
  • The plaintiff is likely to be misled by the defendant's prior statements.
  • The plaintiff is mistaken about a basic fact of the transaction that the defendant is aware of and should disclose (in a minority of jurisdictions).


Here, the collector did not know the seller (no fiduciary relationship) and did not discuss the bank or its value with the seller before purchasing it (no prior misleading statements). And though the collector was aware of the seller's mistake about the bank's worth, he would not be expected to correct it - even in a minority jurisdiction - since people are generally entitled to use their superior knowledge or expertise while bargaining (Choice D). Therefore, the collector had no duty to disclose the bank's worth to the seller, and the seller is unlikely to prevail.†

†The outcome would likely be the same even if the collector did have a duty to disclose the bank's true value to the seller because fraud also requires proof that the plaintiff relied on the defendant's misrepresentation. Here, there was no reliance since the seller set the price for the bank before the collector approached her.

(Choice A) Fraud can occur absent an active misrepresentation if the defendant has an affirmative duty to disclose a material fact to the plaintiff (not seen here) but fails to do so.

(Choice C) The difference between the price paid by the collector and the bank's true value has no bearing on the collector's duty of disclosure (or lack thereof).

Educational objective: An affirmative duty to disclose a material fact exists if the plaintiff is (1) in a fiduciary relationship with the defendant, (2) likely to be misled by the defendant's prior statements, or (3) mistaken about a basic fact of the transaction that the defendant is aware of and should disclose (minority of jurisdictions).



选项正确率统计：A选项 22%，B选项 67%（正确选项），C选项 0%，D选项 9%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

欺诈 (Fraud)（即故意虚假陈述）可能在被告主动虚假陈述或隐瞒重要事实时发生。当被告未能披露重要事实时，欺诈也可能发生——但前提是被告有披露义务。在三种有限的情况下，存在主动披露重要事实的义务：
  • 原告与被告之间存在信托关系 (fiduciary relationship)。
  • 原告可能被被告先前的陈述误导。
  • 原告对交易的基本事实存在误解，而被告意识到此误解且本应披露（在少数司法管辖区适用）。


在本案中，收藏家不认识卖家（没有信托关系），并且在购买前没有与卖家讨论过储蓄罐或其价值（没有先前的误导性陈述）。而且，尽管收藏家意识到卖家对储蓄罐价值的错误，但即使在少数司法管辖区，他也没有义务纠正这个错误——因为人们在讨价还价时通常有权利用其优越的知识或专业技能（选项D）。因此，收藏家没有义务向卖家披露储蓄罐的价值，卖家不可能胜诉。†

†即使收藏家有义务向卖家披露储蓄罐的真实价值，结果也可能相同，因为欺诈还要求证明原告信赖了被告的虚假陈述。在本案中，不存在信赖关系，因为卖家在收藏家接触她之前就已经为储蓄罐定价了。

（选项A）如果被告有主动向原告披露重要事实的义务（本案中没有），但未能这样做，即使没有主动的虚假陈述，欺诈也可能发生。

（选项C）收藏家支付的价格与储蓄罐真实价值之间的差异，与收藏家的披露义务（或缺乏该义务）无关。

教学目标： 如果原告 (1) 与被告存在信托关系，(2) 可能被被告先前的陈述误导，或 (3) 对交易的基本事实存在误解，而被告意识到此误解且本应披露（在少数司法管辖区适用），则存在主动披露重要事实的义务。

References

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 551 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (liability for nondisclosure).

MBE 考点解析

Torts: Fraud & Nondisclosure
正确答案：B 不会胜诉。因为收藏家没有义务向卖家披露该储蓄罐的真实价值。
⚖️ 核心法律规则

本题考察的是侵权法中欺诈（Fraud/Deceit）的构成要件，特别是不作为/沉默（Nondisclosure）是否构成欺诈。

一般原则：无披露义务
General Rule: No Duty to Disclose

在正常的商业交易（arm's-length transaction）中，一方通常没有义务向另一方披露所有重要事实。如果一方保持沉默，通常不构成欺诈，除非存在特定的例外情况。

例外情况：何时必须披露？
Exceptions: Duty to Disclose

只有在以下情况，沉默才构成欺诈：

  • 存在信托/受托关系 (Fiduciary relationship)。
  • 为了纠正之前的误导性陈述 (To correct a prior misleading statement)。
  • 存在主动隐瞒行为 (Active concealment)。
  • (少数管辖区) 对方对交易的基本事实存在错误，且不披露违背诚信原则。
🔍 案情具体分析

在本案中，收藏家（买方）利用了自己的专业知识捡漏：

  • 无信托关系：买卖双方是陌生人，不存在 fiduciary duty。
  • 无虚假陈述：买方只是付钱，没有说话，没有误导卖家。
  • 无主动隐瞒：买方没有掩盖储蓄罐的标记或特征。

关键点：法律允许当事人在讨价还价中利用其优越的知识（Superior Knowledge）或专业技能。特别是关于物品的价值（Value）而非物品的缺陷（Defect），买方通常没有义务“教育”卖方。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A 错
虽然欺诈通常涉及主动陈述，但说法太绝对。如果有披露义务（如受托人），沉默也可以构成欺诈。本题选B是因为具体情境下无义务，而不是因为沉默永远不构成欺诈。
选项 C 错
价格差异巨大（200倍）虽然令人同情，但在合同法或侵权法中，单纯的对价不充分（Inadequacy of consideration）或价值差异本身并不产生披露义务。
选项 D 错
这是最强的干扰项。虽然买方知道卖方搞错了价值，但在商业交易中，利用对方对市场价值的无知是可以接受的商业行为。除非是关于交易基础事实的根本性错误（如卖方不知道那是真金，以为是黄铜，且买方有恶意），否则仅关于“价值”的判断不需要披露。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到“捡漏”或“信息不对称”的题目时：

  1. 判断是事实缺陷（如房子有白蚁）还是价值判断（如古董很值钱）。
  2. 如果是卖方隐瞒缺陷，通常倾向于认定有披露义务（尤其涉及安全或隐蔽缺陷）。
  3. 如果是买方利用专业知识发现高价值，通常没有披露义务。

questions.question:
A woman and a man, who were professional rivals, were attending a computer industry dinner where each was to receive an award for achievement in the field of data processing. The man engaged the woman in conversation and expressed the opinion that if they joined forces, they could do even better. The woman replied that she would not consider him as a business partner. When the man demanded to know why, the woman attempted to offend him by stating that he was incompetent.
The exchange was overheard by a guest who attended the dinner. The man suffered emotional distress but no pecuniary loss.
If the man asserts a claim against the woman based on defamation, will he prevail?

choices.a: No, because the man suffered no pecuniary loss.
choices.b: No, because the woman's statement was made to the man and not to the guest.
choices.c: Yes, because the woman intended to cause the man emotional distress.
choices.d: Yes, because the woman should have foreseen that her statement would be overheard by another person.

data.questionStem:
Q83191

A woman and a man, who were professional rivals, were attending a computer industry dinner where each was to receive an award for achievement in the field of data processing. The man engaged the woman in conversation and expressed the opinion that if they joined forces, they could do even better. The woman replied that she would not consider him as a business partner. When the man demanded to know why, the woman attempted to offend him by stating that he was incompetent.

The exchange was overheard by a guest who attended the dinner. The man suffered emotional distress but no pecuniary loss.

If the man asserts a claim against the woman based on defamation, will he prevail?

一名女性和一名男性是职业竞争对手，他们正在参加一个计算机行业的晚宴，两人都将因在数据处理领域的成就而获奖。该男性与该女性交谈，并表示如果他们联手，可以做得更好。该女性回答说，她不会考虑他作为商业伙伴。当该男性追问原因时，该女性试图通过声称他能力不足来冒犯他。

他们的交谈被一位参加晚宴的客人无意中听到。该男性遭受了精神痛苦，但没有金钱损失。

如果该男性基于诽谤对该女性提起诉讼，他会胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because the man suffered no pecuniary loss.
不会，因为该男性没有遭受金钱损失。

B. No, because the woman's statement was made to the man and not to the guest.
不会，因为该女性的陈述是向该男性作出的，而不是向客人作出的。

C. No, unless the woman intended to cause the man emotional distress.
不会，除非该女性意图对该男性造成精神痛苦。

D. No, unless the woman should have foreseen that her statement would be overheard by another person.
不会，除非该女性本应预见到她的陈述会被他人无意中听到。
data.explanation:
Defamation Elements


ElementAnalysis
Defamatory StatementA statement of fact that harms reputation.
PublicationCommunication to a third party (can be intentional or negligent).
DamagesPecuniary loss required for slander, unless it is slander per se.
The structure 'No, unless...' means the man will lose unless the stated condition is met, in which case he will win. To prevail in a defamation claim, the man must establish several elements. The key issues here are publication and damages.

Publication occurs when the defamatory statement is communicated to a third party. This communication can be intentional or negligent. Negligent publication occurs if it is reasonably foreseeable that a third party might overhear the statement. Here, the conversation took place at a dinner, a public setting where it is foreseeable that others might overhear. The man will prevail only if he can prove this element.

(Choice D) This is the correct answer. It accurately states the legal test for negligent publication. The man's entire case hinges on whether the woman's statement was 'published' to the guest. Since she did not speak directly to the guest, she is only liable if she was negligent in allowing the statement to be overheard. Therefore, the man will not prevail, unless he can prove the woman should have foreseen the statement would be overheard. This correctly frames the central issue.

(Choice A) This is incorrect. Generally, slander requires proof of special damages (pecuniary loss). However, an exception exists for slander per se, which includes statements adversely affecting one's profession or business. Calling a professional 'incompetent' falls into this category. Damages are presumed, so the man does not need to prove pecuniary loss.

(Choice B) This is incorrect. The law does not care who the statement was directed at if it was negligently published to a third party. The fact that the woman spoke to the man does not absolve her if she should have foreseen that a guest would overhear.

(Choice C) This is incorrect. The woman's intent to cause emotional distress is an element of the tort of Intentional Infliction of Emotional Distress (IIED), not defamation.

Not a Protected Opinion: It is also important to note that the statement 'he was incompetent' is not a protected opinion in this context. While pure opinion is not actionable, a statement that implies a factual basis is. Stating that a professional receiving an award is 'incompetent' implies knowledge of facts about the man's work that support the assertion. A reasonble trier of fact would treat this as a defamatory statement of fact.

诽谤的构成要件


构成要件分析
诽谤性陈述损害声誉的事实陈述。
公布向第三方传播（可以是故意的或过失的）。
损害口头诽谤要求金钱损失，除非是本身即属诽谤的口头诽谤。
“不会，除非...”的提问结构意味着，除非所述条件成立，否则该男性将会败诉；如果条件成立，他则会胜诉。要在一项诽谤索赔中胜诉，该男性必须证明几个构成要件。本案的关键问题在于“公布”和“损害”。

公布（Publication）指将诽谤性陈述传达给第三方。这种传播可以是故意的，也可以是过失的。过失公布（Negligent publication）发生在可以合理预见到第三方可能会无意中听到该陈述的情况下。在本案中，对话发生在晚宴上，这是一个公共场合，可以预见到他人可能会听到对话。该男性只有在能够证明这一要素的情况下才能胜诉。

(选项D) 这是正确答案。它准确地陈述了“过失公布”的法律检验标准。该男性的整个案件都取决于该女性的陈述是否被“公布”给了客人。由于她没有直接对客人说话，只有在她因过失而让陈述被听到时，她才需承担责任。因此，该男性不会胜诉，除非他能证明该女性本应预见到该陈述会被他人听到。这正确地构建了本案的核心问题。

(选项A) 这是不正确的。通常情况下，口头诽谤需要证明特殊损害（金钱损失）。然而，对于本身即属诽谤的口头诽谤（slander per se）存在一个例外，这包括对个人职业或业务产生不利影响的陈述。称一个专业人士“能力不足”就属于这一类别。在这种情况下，损害是被法律推定的，因此该男性无需证明金'钱损失。

(选项B) 这是不正确的。如果诽谤性陈述是因过失而向第三方公布的，那么法律并不关心该陈述的直接对象是谁。该女性对该男性说话这一事实，并不能免除她的责任，如果她本应预见到客人会听到的话。

(选项C) 这是不正确的。该女性意图造成精神痛苦是“故意施加精神痛苦”（IIED）这一侵权行为的构成要件，而非诽谤的构成要件。

并非受保护的意见：同样需要注意的是，在本案情境下，“他能力不足”这一陈述并非受保护的意见。虽然纯粹的意见不受追究，但暗示存在事实基础的陈述则不然。声称一个正在领奖的专业人士“能力不足”，暗示说话者知道有关该男性工作表现的事实来支持其断言。一个理性的陪审团可能会将此类陈述视为具有诽谤性的事实陈述。

References

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 577 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (intentional or negligent communication).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Torts: Defamation

本题考察的是侵权法中诽谤（Defamation）的核心构成要件，特别是关于“公布”（Publication）的界定以及“本身即属诽谤”（Slander Per Se）的损害赔偿规则。

考点 1 公布 (Publication)

诽谤成立必须满足“公布”这一要件，即被告必须将诽谤性言论传达给第三方（Third Party）。

  • 故意公布 (Intentional Publication)：被告有意让第三方听到。
  • 过失公布 (Negligent Publication)：被告虽然是针对原告说话，但应当预见到（Foreseeable）第三方可能会听到。

本案分析：女性是直接对男性说话的，并非故意讲给客人听。因此，她是否承担责任，取决于她是否具有过失（Negligent）。如果在一个嘈杂的晚宴上，她应当预见到大声说话会被旁人听到，那么“公布”要件成立。

考点 2 本身即属诽谤 (Slander Per Se)

通常，口头诽谤（Slander）要求原告证明金钱损失（Pecuniary Loss / Special Damages）。但是，如果言论属于 Slander Per Se 的四类情况之一，损害被法律推定，无需证明金钱损失。

四类情况包括：

  1. 严重犯罪；
  2. 令人厌恶的疾病；
  3. 对商业、行业或职业不利的言论（Adverse to business/profession）；
  4. 严重的性行为不端。

本案分析：女性称男性“能力不足”（Incompetent），直接攻击了他的职业能力。因此属于 Slander Per Se，不需要证明金钱损失。

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 D)

"No, unless the woman should have foreseen..."

这个选项精准地抓住了本案的决胜点：过失公布（Negligent Publication）。

因为女性没有直接向客人陈述，所以只有当她“应当预见到”（should have foreseen）会被偷听时，法律上的“公布”才成立。如果这一条件满足，加上 Slander Per Se 不需要证明金钱损失，男性就会胜诉。

🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？
  • 选项 A (金钱损失)： 错误。如上所述，本案属于 Slander Per Se，无需证明 Pecuniary Loss。
  • 选项 B (对象)： 错误。法律不看你“想”对谁说，而看你是否过失地让第三方听到了。
  • 选项 C (意图造成痛苦)： 错误。这是“故意施加精神痛苦”（IIED）的要件，不是诽谤的要件。诽谤关注的是声誉受损，而非情感伤害的意图。
🎓 MBE 解题技巧
注意 "No, unless..." 这种句式。这通常意味着原告目前处于劣势（No），但如果满足某个特定条件（Unless），局势就会反转。

在本题中，原告的劣势在于话是私下说的（看似没有 Publication），反转的关键就在于证明这是“过失公布”。

questions.question:
A manufacturing company constructed a factory near a small town. Five years later, a woman purchased a home one mile away from the factory. Her home is the only residence within five miles of the factory. During this time, the company had steady business but produced very little smoke.
Two years after the woman moved into her home, the company secured several large contracts and expanded its factory to add several large smokestacks that emit smoke on a continual basis. Other factories commonly use the same number of smokestacks in their operations, and such use complies with government regulations. The woman's home is downwind from the factory, so the smoke constantly blows toward her home. The woman has suffered breathing difficulties, constant headaches, and other sicknesses ever since the factory expanded. The value of her property has also severely declined.
The woman sued the manufacturing company for private nuisance.
Will the woman be likely to prevail as a matter of law?

choices.a: No, because the company used the same number of smokestacks in its operations as other companies and complied with government regulations.
choices.b: No, because the woman knowingly purchased a home one mile away from a factory that was in operation at the time of purchase.
choices.c: Yes, because the smoke caused the value of the woman's property to severely decline.
choices.d: Yes, because the smoke unreasonably interfered with the woman's use and enjoyment of her property.

Q83165

Two years after the woman moved into her home, the company secured several large contracts and expanded its factory to add several large smokestacks that emit smoke on a continual basis. Other factories commonly use the same number of smokestacks in their operations, and such use complies with government regulations. The woman's home is downwind from the factory, so the smoke constantly blows toward her home. The woman has suffered breathing difficulties, constant headaches, and other sicknesses ever since the factory expanded. The value of her property has also severely declined.

The woman sued the manufacturing company for private nuisance.

Will the woman be likely to prevail as a matter of law?

一家制造公司在一个小镇附近建了一家工厂。五年后，一名女子在距离工厂一英里远的地方购买了一处住宅。她的住宅是工厂方圆五英里内唯一的住所。在此期间，该公司的业务稳定，但产生的烟雾很少。

在该女子搬入新家两年后，该公司获得了几份大额合同，并扩建了工厂，增加了几个持续排放烟雾的大烟囱。其他工厂在运营中通常也使用同样数量的烟囱，并且这种使用符合政府规定。该女子的住宅位于工厂的下风向，因此烟雾不断地吹向她的住宅。自从工厂扩建以来，该女子一直遭受呼吸困难、持续性头痛和其他疾病的困扰。她的财产价值也严重下降。

该女子以私有妨害为由起诉了该制造公司。

在法律上，该女子是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the company used the same number of smokestacks in its operations as other companies and complied with government regulations.
不会，因为该公司在其运营中使用了与其他公司相同数量的烟囱，并遵守了政府规定。

B. No, because the woman knowingly purchased a home one mile away from a factory that was in operation at the time of purchase.
不会，因为该女子在购买时明知其住宅距离一家正在运营的工厂一英里远。

C. Yes, because the smoke caused the value of the woman's property to severely decline.
会，因为烟雾导致该女子的财产价值严重下降。

D. Yes, because the smoke unreasonably interfered with the woman's use and enjoyment of her property.
会，因为烟雾不合理地妨碍了该女子对其财产的使用和享用。
data.explanation:
A private nuisance claim requires proof that the defendant's interference with the plaintiff's use and enjoyment of his/her property was both:
  • substantial - offensive, annoying, or intolerable to a normal person in the community and
  • unreasonable - the severity of the plaintiff's harm outweighs the utility of the defendant's conduct.


Severe harm (eg, physical harm to those on the property) always outweighs the utility of the defendant's conduct. As a result, an interference that causes severe harm is unreasonable as a matter of law.

Here, the smoke from the factory interfered with the woman's use and enjoyment of her property by causing her physical harm and reducing the value of her property. The interference was substantial since a normal homeowner would find it annoying or intolerable. It was also unreasonable because the smoke caused the woman severe harm - including difficulty breathing and constant headaches. Therefore, she will likely prevail on this claim.

(Choice A) The company's interference is unreasonable as a matter of law because it caused severe harm. Therefore, evidence of the company's reasonableness - ie, operating with the same number of smokestacks as other companies and complying with government regulations - is no defense.

(Choice B) Whether a plaintiff "came to the nuisance" because the nuisance existed before the plaintiff moved in is merely one factor that may be considered in determining whether an interference is actionable. It is not a defense.

(Choice C) The woman could recover damages for the reduction of her property's value caused by the smoke, but this is not required for her to prevail. Instead, she will prevail because the smoke unreasonably interfered with her use and enjoyment of her property.

Educational objective: Private nuisance is an interference with the plaintiff's use and enjoyment of his/her property that is both substantial (ie, offensive, annoying, or intolerable to a normal person in the community) and unreasonable (ie, severity of the harm outweighs the utility of the conduct). Severe harm is unreasonable as a matter of law.



选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 10%，C选项 2%，D选项 81%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

一项私有妨害 (private nuisance) 主张要求证明被告对原告财产使用和享用的妨碍 (interference) 同时满足以下两点：
  • 实质性的 (substantial) - 对于社区中的一个正常人而言，是冒犯性的、令人烦恼的或无法忍受的，并且
  • 不合理的 (unreasonable) - 原告所受损害的严重性超过了被告行为的功用性。


严重损害 (Severe harm)（例如，对地产上的人身伤害）总是超过被告行为的功用性。因此，造成严重损害的妨碍在法律上被认定为不合理的 (unreasonable as a matter of law)。

在本案中，工厂的烟雾通过对该女子造成人身伤害并降低其财产价值，妨碍了她对财产的使用和享用。该妨碍是实质性的，因为一个正常的房主会认为它是令人烦恼或无法忍受的。它也是不合理的，因为烟雾对该女子造成了严重损害——包括呼吸困难和持续性头痛。因此，她很可能在这一主张上胜诉。

(选项 A) 该公司的妨碍在法律上是不合理的，因为它造成了严重损害。因此，证明公司行为合理性的证据——即，使用与其他公司相同数量的烟囱并遵守政府规定——不能作为抗辩理由。

(选项 B) 原告是否因为在搬入前妨害就已存在而“自投妨害 (came to the nuisance)”，这仅仅是在确定妨碍是否可诉时可能考虑的一个因素。它不能作为抗辩理由。

(选项 C) 该女子可以就烟雾造成的财产价值减少获得损害赔偿，但这不是她胜诉的必要条件。相反，她会胜诉是因为烟雾不合理地妨碍了她对财产的使用和享用。

教学目标：私有妨害是指对原告财产使用和享用的妨碍，该妨碍既是实质性的（即，对社区中的正常人而言是冒犯性的、令人烦恼的或无法忍受的），又是不合理的（即，损害的严重性超过行为的功用性）。严重损害在法律上被认定为不合理的。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Torts §§ 167, 821D (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (private nuisance).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 826 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (unreasonable interference required).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 829A cmt. b (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (severe harm).

MBE 考点解析

侵权法 (Torts) - 私有妨害

核心概念：私有妨害 (Private Nuisance)

私有妨害是指对原告使用和享用其土地的权利造成了实质性 (Substantial) 且 不合理 (Unreasonable) 的非侵入式干扰 (Non-trespassory interference)。

法律规则详解

在判断干扰是否“不合理”时，法院通常会进行权衡测试 (Balancing Test)：比较原告受到的伤害严重程度与被告行为的社会效用。

但是，MBE 考试中有一个非常重要的例外规则（也是本题的关键）：

如果干扰对原告造成了严重的人身伤害 (Severe Physical Harm)，则该干扰在法律上直接被视为“不合理” (Unreasonable as a matter of law)。

此时，不再需要权衡被告工厂的经济效益或社会价值。

正确答案 D

理由：题目明确指出，由于工厂扩建排放烟雾，该女子遭受了“呼吸困难、持续性头痛和其他疾病”。

这属于严重的人身伤害。根据侵权法原则，造成严重人身伤害的干扰自动满足“不合理”这一要件。因此，烟雾不合理地妨碍了她对财产的使用和享用，她将胜诉。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (合规抗辩) - 错误 虽然遵守政府规定 (Government Regulations) 是证明被告行为“合理”的证据之一，但它不是绝对的免责金牌。一旦造成了严重的人身伤害，即使合规也不能免除私有妨害的责任。
选项 B (自投妨害) - 错误 “自投妨害” (Coming to the nuisance) 即原告搬到了污染源附近。在现代法律中，这只是法院考虑的一个因素 (Factor)，而不是被告的绝对抗辩理由 (Defense)。它不能阻止原告胜诉。
选项 C (财产贬值) - 错误 这是一个极具迷惑性的选项。虽然财产贬值是事实，也是计算损害赔偿 (Damages) 的依据，但它不是胜诉的法律标准。胜诉的法律依据是“不合理的干扰 (Unreasonable Interference)”，而不是贬值本身。D 选项更准确地陈述了法律要件。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到 Nuisance（妨害）题目时，请立即寻找原告是否有身体上的不适（如头痛、恶心、失眠）。

如果有，这通常是出题人在暗示你：“伤害严重，直接判定为不合理 (Unreasonable)”，此时被告的工厂哪怕再赚钱、再合规，也通常会败诉。

questions.question:
When two parents were told that their son should repeat second grade, they sought to have him evaluated by a psychologist. The psychologist, who charged $300, determined that the son had a learning disability. Based upon the report, the school board placed the son in special classes. At an open meeting of the school board about school expenditures, the parents asked that the $300 they had paid to the psychologist be reimbursed by the school district. A reporter attending the meeting wrote a newspaper article about this request, mentioning the son by name.
In a privacy action brought by the son's legal representative against the newspaper, will the plaintiff recover?

choices.a: No, if the parents knew that the reporter was present.
choices.b: No, if the story is a fair and accurate report of what transpired at the meeting.
choices.c: Yes, because the son is under the age of consent.
choices.d: Yes, because the story is not newsworthy.

当一对父母被告知他们的儿子应该重读二年级时，他们寻求一位心理学家对儿子进行评估。这位心理学家收费300美元，并确定该儿子有学习障碍。根据这份报告，学校董事会将该儿子安排到特殊班级。在一次关于学校支出的公开的学校董事会会议上，这对父母要求学区报销他们支付给心理学家的300美元。一名参加会议的记者就这一请求写了一篇报纸文章，其中提到了儿子的名字。

在该儿子的法定代理人对报社提起的隐私权诉讼中，原告能否胜诉？
options:
A. No, if the parents knew that the reporter was present.
不会，如果父母知道记者在场。

B. No, if the story is a fair and accurate report of what transpired at the meeting.
不会，如果该报道是对会议上所发生事件的公正且准确的报告。

C. Yes, because the son is under the age of consent.
会，因为该儿子未达到同意年龄。

D. Yes, because the story is not newsworthy.
会，因为该报道不具有新闻价值。
data.explanation:
Invasion-of-privacy privileges


Absolute privileges
  • Consent to publication
  • Publication by participant in judicial or legislative proceeding
  • Publication by executive or administrative officer
  • Publication to spouse
  • Publication required by law
Conditional privileges
(lost if abused)
  • Publication serves important public or private interest
  • Publication to someone with common interest (eg, business partner)
  • Publication by inferior state officer
  • Report of official proceeding or public meeting
Liability for invasion of privacy based on public disclosure of private facts arises when:

  • the defendant publicly disclosed facts about the plaintiff's private life

  • that disclosure would be highly offensive to a reasonable person

  • the disclosed facts are not of legitimate public interest and

  • the disclosure caused the plaintiff harm.


However, the defendant is privileged to disclose such facts if (1) the disclosure was in a fair and accurate report of a public meeting and (2) the meeting dealt with matters of legitimate public interest (ie, newsworthy topics).

Here, the reporter publicized the son's psychological evaluation (private fact) - a disclosure that would be highly offensive to a reasonable person and is not of legitimate public interest. However, the parents requested reimbursement for that evaluation at an open school board meeting about a matter of public interest - school expenditures. Therefore, the reporter's disclosure would be privileged if it was a fair and accurate report of that meeting, and the son's privacy action would fail.

(Choice A) A defendant's privilege to publicize a fair and accurate report of a public meeting does not depend on anyone's knowledge of the defendant's presence. Therefore, it does not matter whether the parents knew that the reporter was present.

(Choice C) Although consent is a defense to a privacy claim based on public disclosure of private facts, it does not apply here since the son was under the age of consent. Nevertheless, the reporter may have been privileged to publicize the son's psychological evaluation since it was discussed at a public meeting regarding a matter of public interest. In that case, the son would not recover.

(Choice D) The story is newsworthy because a school board's consideration of expenditures (eg, reimbursing the parents for the son's psychological evaluation) is a matter of public interest.

Educational objective: A defendant is privileged to publicly disclose facts about the plaintiff's private life if (1) the disclosure is in a fair and accurate report of a public meeting and (2) that meeting dealt with matters of legitimate public interest.

选项正确率统计：A选项 11%，B选项 60%（正确选项），C选项 13%，D选项 13%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

侵犯隐私权的特权


绝对特权
  • 对公布的同意
  • 司法或立法程序参与者的公布行为
  • 行政官员的公布行为
  • 向配偶的公布
  • 法律要求的公布
有条件的特权
(如果滥用则丧失)
  • 公布行为服务于重要的公共或私人利益
  • 向有共同利益的人公布（例如，商业伙伴）
  • 下级政府官员的公布行为
  • 对官方程序或公开会议的报道
基于公开披露私密事实的侵犯隐私权责任在以下情况下产生：

  • 被告公开披露了有关原告私生活的事实

  • 该披露对一个通情达理的人来说是极具冒犯性的

  • 所披露的事实不涉及合法的公共利益并且

  • 该披露对原告造成了损害。


然而，如果满足以下条件，被告享有披露此类事实的特权：(1) 该披露是在对一次公开会议的公正且准确的报告中进行的，并且 (2) 该会议涉及合法的公共利益事项（即，具有新闻价值的话题）。

在本案中，记者公布了儿子的心理评估（私密事实）——这一披露对一个通情达理的人来说是极具冒犯性的，并且不涉及合法的公共利益。然而，父母是在一次关于公共利益事项——学校支出的公开学校董事会会议上请求报销该评估费用的。因此，如果记者的披露是对该会议的公正且准确的报告，那么该披露将享有特权，儿子的隐私权诉讼将会败诉。

(选项A) 被告对公开会议进行公正且准确报道的特权，不取决于任何人是否知晓被告在场。因此，父母是否知道记者在场并不重要。

(选项C) 尽管同意是针对基于公开披露私密事实的隐私权主张的一项抗辩理由，但它在此处不适用，因为儿子未达到同意年龄。尽管如此，记者可能享有公布儿子心理评估的特权，因为这是在一次关于公共利益事项的公开会议上讨论的。在这种情况下，儿子将无法胜诉。

(选项D) 该报道具有新闻价值，因为学校董事会对支出（例如，为父母报销儿子的心理评估费用）的审议是公共利益事项。

教学目标：如果满足以下条件，被告享有公开披露原告私生活事实的特权：(1) 该披露是在对一次公开会议的公正且准确的报告中进行的，并且 (2) 该会议涉及合法的公共利益事项。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 652D (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (public disclosure of private facts).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts §§ 611, 652G (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (privilege to report public meeting).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：侵犯隐私权与公开会议报道

本题考查的是侵权法（Torts）中关于侵犯隐私权（Invasion of Privacy）的一个具体分支：公开披露私密事实（Public Disclosure of Private Facts），以及媒体享有的特权（Privilege）。

⚖️ 核心法律规则

一般原则：如果被告公开披露了关于原告私生活的私密事实，且该披露对普通人来说极具冒犯性，且不属于合法的公共利益，则构成侵权。

关键抗辩（特权）：
根据《侵权法重述（第二版）》Restatement (Second) of Torts § 611，如果披露是基于对公开的官方程序或会议（Public Meeting/Official Proceeding）的公正且准确的报道（Fair and Accurate Report），则被告享有特权，无需承担责任。

💡 案件逻辑分析

1. 信息的性质

儿子的学习障碍和心理评估报告通常属于高度私密的信息（Private Facts）。如果记者通过非法手段获取并曝光，通常会构成侵权。

2. 信息的来源与场景

本案的关键在于，这些信息是在一次公开的学校董事会会议（Open Meeting of the School Board）上被披露的。父母为了申请报销（涉及公共资金/School Expenditures），主动在公开场合提及了此事。

3. 媒体的权利

会议涉及公共利益（学校预算和支出）。记者有权报道公开会议的内容。只要报道是公正且准确（Fair and Accurate）地记录了会议上发生的事情，这种披露就是受保护的（Privileged）。

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 B)

选项 B 正确。
即使披露的事实本身很私密，但一旦它成为公开会议记录的一部分，媒体对其进行准确报道就享有有条件的特权（Conditional Privilege）。原告无法胜诉，因为这种特权阻断了隐私权诉讼的成立。

❌ 干扰项排除

  • 选项 A (父母知情)： 错误。公开会议的性质决定了报道的合法性，不取决于当事人是否注意到记者在场。会议本身是公开的（Open Meeting），即视为对公众开放。
  • 选项 C (同意年龄)： 错误。虽然“同意”（Consent）是抗辩理由之一，但本案的胜诉点不在于儿子是否同意，而在于媒体报道公开会议的特权。即使儿子未成年，也不能阻止媒体报道公开的政府会议内容。
  • 选项 D (新闻价值)： 错误。学校董事会如何使用资金（报销费用）绝对属于合法的公共利益（Legitimate Public Interest/Newsworthy），因此该抗辩理由成立，原告不能以此为由胜诉。

🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理 MBE 隐私权题目时，请遵循以下步骤：

  1. 判断是否属于“私密事实”（Private Facts）。
  2. 检查信息来源：如果是从公开记录（Public Record）或公开程序（Open Proceeding）中获取的，宪法第一修正案通常会保护媒体的报道权，原告很难胜诉。
  3. 寻找关键词：“Open meeting”（公开会议）、“Public record”（公共记录）。

questions.question:
A real estate developer was trying to purchase land on which he intended to build a large commercial development. An elderly widow had rejected all of the developer's offers to buy her ancestral home, where she had lived all her life and which was located in the middle of the developer's planned development. Finally, the developer offered her $250,000. He told her that it was his last offer and that if she rejected it, state law authorized him to have her property condemned.
The widow then consulted her nephew, a law student, who researched the question and advised her that the developer had no power of condemnation under state law. The widow had been frightened by the developer's threat and was outraged when she learned that the developer had lied to her.
If the widow asserts a claim based on misrepresentation against the developer, will she prevail?

choices.a: No, because the widow suffered no pecuniary loss.
choices.b: No, if the developer's offer of $250,000 equaled or exceeded the market value of the widow's property.
choices.c: Yes, if the developer knew he had no legal power of condemnation.
choices.d: Yes, if the developer tried to take unfair advantage of a gross difference between himself and the widow in commercial knowledge and experience.

If the widow asserts a claim based on misrepresentation against the developer, will she prevail?

一位房地产开发商正试图购买一块土地，他打算在这块土地上建造一个大型商业开发项目。一位年迈的寡妇拒绝了开发商所有购买她祖宅的要约，她一生都住在这栋祖宅里，而该祖宅正位于开发商规划的开发项目中心。最终，开发商向她要约25万美元。他告诉她这是他最后的要约，如果她拒绝，州法律授权他征收她的财产。

随后，寡妇咨询了她的侄子，一名法学院学生。她的侄子研究了这个问题并告知她，根据州法律，该开发商没有征收权。寡妇被开发商的威胁吓到了，当她得知开发商对她撒了谎时，她感到非常愤怒。

如果该寡妇以虚假陈述为由对开发商提起诉讼，她会胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because the widow suffered no pecuniary loss.
不会，因为寡妇没有遭受金钱损失。

B. No, if the developer's offer of $250,000 equaled or exceeded the market value of the widow's property.
不会，如果开发商25万美元的要约等于或超过了寡妇财产的市场价值。

C. Yes, if the developer knew he had no legal power of condemnation.
会，如果开发商知道他没有法定的征收权。

D. Yes, if the developer tried to take unfair advantage of a gross difference between himself and the widow in commercial knowledge and experience.
会，如果开发商试图利用他与寡妇在商业知识和经验上的巨大差异来获取不公平的优势。
data.explanation:
To establish a prima facie case of intentional misrepresentation (ie, fraud or deceit), the plaintiff must show that:
  • the defendant knowingly or recklessly misrepresented a material fact with the intent to induce the plaintiff's reliance and
  • the plaintiff reasonably relied on the misrepresentation and suffered pecuniary loss (ie, monetary loss) as a result.
Here, the developer may have knowingly or recklessly misrepresented state law with the intent to persuade the widow to sell her home. But since the widow did not rely on the developer's statement (eg, by selling her home) and suffered no pecuniary loss (eg, by selling her home for less than its worth), she will not prevail on a misrepresentation claim.

(Choice B) The widow did not sell her home in reliance on the developer's statement (and therefore could not have suffered pecuniary loss), so it does not matter whether the developer's offer equaled or exceeded the market value of her home.

(Choice C) Even if the developer knew that he had no legal power of condemnation (ie, he knowingly misrepresented a material fact), the widow will not prevail because she did not rely on his misrepresentation or suffer a pecuniary loss.

(Choice D) The developer's superior commercial knowledge and his experience go to whether the widow could have reasonably relied on his misrepresentation. But since the widow did not rely on his statement, his knowledge and experience are irrelevant.

Educational objective: Liability for intentional misrepresentation arises when (1) the defendant knowingly or recklessly misrepresents a material fact with the intent to induce the plaintiff's reliance and (2) the plaintiff reasonably relies on the misrepresentation and suffers pecuniary loss as a result.



选项正确率统计：A选项 73%（正确选项），B选项 1%，C选项 15%，D选项 9%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

要构成故意虚假陈述（即欺诈或诓骗）的初步证据案件（prima facie case），原告必须证明：
  • 被告明知或鲁莽地对重要事实作出虚假陈述，意图诱使原告信赖并且
  • 原告合理地信赖了该虚假陈述，并因此遭受了金钱损失（即 monetary loss）。
在本案中，开发商可能明知或鲁莽地对州法律作出了虚假陈述，意图说服寡妇出售她的房屋。但由于寡妇并未信赖开发商的陈述（例如，没有因此出售房屋），也没有遭受任何金钱损失（例如，没有以低于其价值的价格出售房屋），因此她基于虚假陈述的诉讼请求将不会胜诉。

(选项 B) 寡妇并未因信赖开发商的陈述而出售其房屋（因此不可能遭受金钱损失），所以开发商的要约是否等于或超过其房屋的市场价值并不重要。

(选项 C) 即使开发商知道他没有法定的征收权（即他故意对重要事实作出虚假陈述），寡妇也不会胜诉，因为她没有信赖他的虚假陈述，也没有遭受金钱损失。

(选项 D) 开发商更优越的商业知识和经验关系到寡妇是否可以合理地信赖其虚假陈述。但由于寡妇并未信赖其陈述，因此他的知识和经验是无关紧要的。

教学目标：当 (1) 被告为诱使原告信赖而故意或鲁莽地对重要事实作出虚假陈述，且 (2) 原告合理信赖该虚假陈述并因此遭受金钱损失时，故意虚假陈述的责任即告成立。

References

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 525 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (fraudulent misrepresentation).

MBE 考点解析

侵权法：故意虚假陈述
(Intentional Misrepresentation)
⚖️ 法律规则 (The Rule) 要确立故意虚假陈述 (Fraud/Deceit) 的责任，原告必须证明以下所有要素：
  • 虚假陈述 (Misrepresentation)：被告对重要事实作出了虚假陈述。
  • 明知 (Scienter)：被告知道陈述是虚假的，或罔顾事实真相。
  • 意图 (Intent)：意图诱使原告信赖该陈述。
  • 因果关系 (Causation/Reliance)：原告实际上信赖了该陈述。
  • 合理信赖 (Justifiable Reliance)：原告的信赖是合理的。
  • 损害 (Damages)：原告因此遭受了实际的金钱损失 (Pecuniary Loss)。
🔍 案情逻辑分析

本案中，开发商确实撒谎了（关于征收权），并且意图欺骗寡妇卖房。这满足了前三个要素。

但是，侵权法中的欺诈诉讼不仅仅看被告的“坏心思”，更看原告是否真的“上当受骗”并“损失钱财”。

开发商撒谎 (Misrepresentation) ✅
↓
开发商意图欺骗 (Intent) ✅
↓
寡妇信赖并行动? (Reliance) ❌
↓
寡妇遭受金钱损失? (Damages) ❌

寡妇咨询了侄子，得知了真相，因此她没有信赖开发商的谎言，也没有出售房屋。虽然她感到愤怒和恐惧（精神痛苦），但对于“故意虚假陈述”这一特定的侵权行为，必须要有金钱损失 (Pecuniary Loss) 才能胜诉。

💡 为什么选 A？
选项 A 正确： "No, because the widow suffered no pecuniary loss."
这是本题的决定性因素。没有金钱损失（例如以低价卖房），欺诈侵权之诉（Tort of Deceit）就无法成立。愤怒或恐惧不足以支持此类诉讼请求。
选项 B 错误： 即使报价高于市场价，只要寡妇没有卖，就没有交易发生，也就谈不上损失。
选项 C 错误： 虽然开发商“明知” (Scienter) 自己在撒谎，但这只是要素之一。仅有恶意而无损害结果，在侵权法中通常不构成责任。
选项 D 错误： 双方实力的差距可能影响“信赖是否合理” (Justifiable Reliance) 的判断，但前提是原告必须先产生了“信赖”。本案中寡妇根本没有信赖，所以无需讨论信赖是否合理。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧：
在处理故意侵权 (Intentional Torts) 题目时，要区分“行为犯”和“结果犯”。
  • 对于 Battery (殴打) 或 Assault (恐吓)，通常不需要证明实际伤害 (Damages)。
  • 但对于 Fraud/Misrepresentation (欺诈) 和 Negligence (过失)，实际损害 (Actual Damages) 是必须证明的要素 (Prima Facie Case) 之一。
如果原告没有亏钱，欺诈诉讼通常不会赢。

questions.question:
A seller sold his boat to a buyer. During negotiations, the buyer said that he planned to sail the boat on the open seas. The seller told the buyer that the boat was seaworthy and had never sustained any significant damage. In fact, the hull of the boat had been badly damaged when the seller had run the boat aground. The seller had then done a cosmetic repair to the hull rather than a structural repair.
The buyer relied on the seller's representations and paid a fair price for a boat in good repair, only to discover after the sale was completed that the hull was in fact badly damaged and in a dangerous condition. The seller has refused to refund any of the buyer's money, and the buyer is contemplating suing the seller.
Under what theory would the buyer be most likely to recover?

choices.a: Fraud.
choices.b: Intentional endangerment.
choices.c: Negligent misrepresentation.
choices.d: Strict products liability.

data.questionStem:
Q83803 A seller sold his boat to a buyer. During negotiations, the buyer said that he planned to sail the boat on the open seas. The seller told the buyer that the boat was seaworthy and had never sustained any significant damage. In fact, the hull of the boat had been badly damaged when the seller had run the boat aground. The seller had then done a cosmetic repair to the hull rather than a structural repair.

The buyer relied on the seller's representations and paid a fair price for a boat in good repair, only to discover after the sale was completed that the hull was in fact badly damaged and in a dangerous condition. The seller has refused to refund any of the buyer's money, and the buyer is contemplating suing the seller.

Under what theory would the buyer be most likely to recover? 卖方将其船只卖给买方。在谈判期间，买方表示他计划在公海上驾驶这艘船。卖方告诉买方，该船适航，且从未遭受任何重大损害。事实上，当卖方让船搁浅时，船体已严重受损。随后，卖方对船体进行了外观上的修复，而非结构性修复。

买方信赖了卖方的陈述，并为一艘维修良好的船支付了合理的价格，但在交易完成后才发现船体实际上已严重受损，并处于危险状态。卖方拒绝退还买方的任何款项，买方正在考虑起诉卖方。

根据哪种理论，买方最有可能获得赔偿？
options:
A. Fraud.
欺诈。

B. Intentional endangerment.
故意危害。

C. Negligent misrepresentation.
过失性虚假陈述。

D. Strict products liability.
严格产品责任。
data.explanation:
Misrepresentation
(fraudulent v. negligent)


ConductSettingHarm
FraudulentKnowingly or recklessly misrepresented material fact to induce relianceAny settingJustifiable reliance caused pecuniary loss
NegligentNegligently provided plaintiff false informationCommercial setting or setting with risk of physical harmJustifiable reliance caused pecuniary loss or physical harm
To recover for fraud (ie, intentional misrepresentation or deceit), the plaintiff must show that:

the defendant knowingly or recklessly misrepresented a material fact with the intent to induce the plaintiff's reliance and

the plaintiff justifiably relied on the defendant's misrepresentation and suffered pecuniary loss (ie, monetary loss).

Here, the seller knowingly misrepresented that the boat had never sustained significant damage with the intent to persuade the buyer to purchase it. Since the seller had cosmetically repaired the boat's damaged hull, the buyer's reliance on that misrepresentation was reasonable. The buyer then suffered a pecuniary loss when he paid a fair price for a boat in good repair but received a badly damaged one. Therefore, the buyer will likely recover for fraud.

(Choice B) Intentional endangerment (conduct that is likely to cause death or serious bodily harm to another) is a theory of criminal liability—not civil liability.

(Choice C) Negligent misrepresentation occurs when a defendant negligently provides the plaintiff with false information in a transaction where the defendant has a pecuniary interest (ie, a commercial setting). Although the seller had a pecuniary interest in the boat transaction, his misrepresentation was made knowingly-not merely negligently. As a result, negligent misrepresentation is not the best theory of recovery.

(Choice D) Strict products liability is only imposed on a commercial supplier (eg, manufacturer, distributor, retailer)—not a casual seller (eg, an individual selling a car to a friend). Since there is no evidence that the seller is a commercial supplier, the buyer is unlikely to recover on this basis.

Educational objective: Fraud (ie, intentional misrepresentation or deceit) liability arises when (1) the defendant knowingly or recklessly misrepresents a material fact with the intent to induce the plaintiff's reliance and (2) the plaintiff reasonably relies on that misrepresentation and suffers pecuniary loss.

虚假陈述
(欺诈性 vs. 过失性)


行为情境损害
欺诈性明知或罔顾后果地对重要事实作出虚假陈述以诱导信赖任何情境正当的信赖导致了金钱损失
过失性因过失向原告提供了虚假信息商业情境或存在身体伤害风险的情境正当的信赖导致了金钱损失或身体伤害
要以欺诈（即故意虚假陈述或欺骗）为由获得赔偿，原告必须证明：

被告明知或罔顾后果地对重要事实作出虚假陈述，并意图诱导原告的信赖并且

原告正当地信赖了被告的虚假陈述并遭受了金钱损失（即 monetary loss）。

在本案中，卖方明知船只从未遭受重大损害的陈述为虚假，却仍作出此陈述，意图说服买方购买该船。由于卖方对船只受损的船体进行了外观修复，买方对该虚假陈述的信赖是合理的。随后，买方支付了维修良好船只的合理价格，却收到了一艘严重受损的船，从而遭受了金钱损失。因此，买方很可能可以因欺诈获得赔偿。

（选项B）故意危害（可能导致他人死亡或严重身体伤害的行为）是一种刑事责任理论，而非民事责任理论。

（选项C）过失性虚假陈述发生于被告在某项交易中存在金钱利益（即商业情境）时，因过失向原告提供了虚假信息。尽管卖方在船只交易中存在金钱利益，但他的虚假陈述是明知的，而不仅仅是过失的。因此，过失性虚假陈述并非最佳的赔偿理论。

（选项D）严格产品责任仅适用于商业供应商（例如，制造商、分销商、零售商），而不适用于偶然的卖方（例如，个人将汽车卖给朋友）。由于没有证据表明卖方是商业供应商，买方不太可能基于此理由获得赔偿。

教学目的：
欺诈（即故意虚假陈述或欺骗）责任的成立条件为：（1）被告明知或罔顾后果地对重要事实作出虚假陈述，意图诱导原告的信赖，以及（2）原告合理地信赖了该虚假陈述并遭受了金钱损失。

References

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 525 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (fraudulent misrepresentation).

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 552 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (negligent misrepresentation).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Torts: Misrepresentation

✅ 正确答案：A. Fraud (欺诈)

本题考查的是故意虚假陈述（Intentional Misrepresentation），即通常所说的欺诈（Fraud/Deceit）。

⚖️ 法律规则解析

构成欺诈（Fraud）的五个核心要素：

1. 虚假陈述 (Misrepresentation)：对重要事实 (Material Fact) 的虚假陈述。
2. 明知/故意 (Scienter)：被告明知陈述是虚假的，或罔顾事实真相。
3. 意图 (Intent)：意图诱导原告信赖该陈述。
4. 因果关系与信赖 (Causation & Reliance)：原告实际上信赖了该陈述，且该信赖是正当的 (Justifiable Reliance)。
5. 损害 (Damages)：原告遭受了金钱损失 (Pecuniary Loss)。
🔍 案情应用

在本案中，卖方的行为完全符合上述要素，特别是Scienter（明知）这一关键点：

  • 明知虚假： 题目明确指出卖方知道船体严重受损，并且自己进行了“外观修复”（cosmetic repair）而非结构修复。这证明他不仅知道真相，还刻意掩盖。
  • 积极陈述： 卖方明确告诉买方船只“适航且从未受过重大损害”。
  • 诱导信赖： 这种掩盖和谎言显然是为了让买方以“好船”的价格购买。

因此，这是典型的故意虚假陈述（Fraud）。

🚫 为什么其他选项错误？
C. Negligent Misrepresentation (过失性虚假陈述)
虽然过失性虚假陈述也涉及虚假信息，但其心态要求仅为“过失”（Negligence）。本题中，卖方进行了掩盖性的外观修复，表明他是故意（Intentional/Knowing）欺骗，而非仅仅是粗心大意。虽然在诉讼中可以作为备选理由，但“欺诈”是对本案事实最准确的定性。
D. Strict Products Liability (严格产品责任)
严格责任仅适用于商业销售商（Commercial Supplier/Merchant），如船行或制造商。题目中描述的是 "A seller sold his boat..."，暗示这是一次私人之间的偶发交易（Casual Sale）。私人卖家不承担严格产品责任。
B. Intentional Endangerment (故意危害)
这不是一个标准的民事侵权（Tort）诉因来追偿金钱损失。这更像是一个刑法概念。在民事诉讼中，买方寻求的是经济赔偿，Fraud 是最合适的理论。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

在处理虚假陈述（Misrepresentation）类题目时，关键在于判断被告的心态（State of Mind）：

  • 如果是明知说谎或刻意隐瞒 ➡️ 选 Fraud。
  • 如果是应当知道但没核实（商业情境）➡️ 选 Negligent Misrepresentation。
  • 如果是无辜的说错话 ➡️ 通常无责任（除非涉及特定保修条款）。

questions.question:
A manufacturing plant emitted a faint noise even though the owner had installed state-of-the-art sound dampeners. The plant operated only on weekdays and only during daylight hours. A homeowner who lived near the plant worked a night shift and could not sleep when he arrived home because of the noise from the plant. The other residents in the area did not notice the noise.
Does the homeowner have a viable nuisance claim against the owner of the plant?

choices.a: No, because the homeowner is unusually sensitive to noise during the day.
choices.b: No, because the plant operates only during the day.
choices.c: Yes, because the noise is heard beyond the boundaries of the plant.
choices.d: Yes, because the operation of the plant interferes with the homeowner's quiet use and enjoyment of his property.

data.questionStem:
Q83169

A manufacturing plant emitted a faint noise even though the owner had installed state-of-the-art sound dampeners. The plant operated only on weekdays and only during daylight hours. A homeowner who lived near the plant worked a night shift and could not sleep when he arrived home because of the noise from the plant. The other residents in the area did not notice the noise.

Does the homeowner have a viable nuisance claim against the owner of the plant?

一家制造厂发出了微弱的噪音，尽管厂主已经安装了最先进的消音器。该工厂仅在工作日的白昼时段运营。一位住在工厂附近的房主上夜班，回家后因工厂的噪音而无法入睡。该区域的其他居民并未注意到此噪音。

该房主能否对工厂主提起一项可行的妨害（nuisance）诉讼请求？
options:
A. No, because the homeowner is unusually sensitive to noise during the day.
否，因为该房主对白天的噪音异常敏感。

B. No, because the plant operates only during the day.
否，因为该工厂仅在白天运营。

C. Yes, because the noise is heard beyond the boundaries of the plant.
是，因为在工厂边界之外可以听到噪音。

D. Yes, because the operation of the plant interferes with the homeowner's quiet use and enjoyment of his property.
是，因为工厂的运营妨碍了房主对其财产的安宁使用和享用。
data.explanation:
Private nuisance v. Public nuisance


(action brought by private plaintiff)InterferenceUnreasonableHarm
PublicPublic right - eg, health, safety, peace, propertyInterference is significant or violated lawSpecial harm - harm different from that of public at large
PrivateUse & enjoyment of propertySeverity of harm outweighs utility of interferenceSubstantial interference - offensive, annoying, or intolerable to normal person
Proof of harm not required when plaintiff is public entity or government actor.

Nuisance can be either public (interfering with a right common to the general public) OR private (interfering with a private property right - as seen here). Liability for private nuisance arises when the defendant's tortious interference with the plaintiff's use and enjoyment of his/her property is both:

  • substantial - offensive, annoying, or intolerable to a normal person in the community and
  • unreasonable - the severity of the plaintiff's harm outweighs the utility of the defendant's conduct.


An interference is not substantial if the plaintiff has an unusual sensitivity that causes him/her to find it offensive, annoying, or intolerable when a normal person in the community would not.

Here, the manufacturing plant interfered with the homeowner's use and enjoyment of his property by emitting a noise that kept him awake during the day (Choice D). But since the homeowner worked a night shift, he was unusually sensitive to the noise that other residents in the community did not notice. Therefore, the interference was not substantial and the homeowner does not have a viable nuisance claim.

(Choice B) Although the plant only operates during the day, the homeowner could still recover if the noise was offensive, annoying, or intolerable to normal people in the community (eg, had the other residents found the noise too loud for daytime).

(Choice C) The noise was heard beyond the boundaries of the plant - but only by the homeowner. Since the homeowner was disturbed by that noise when none of the other residents noticed it (ie, he was unusually sensitive), his nuisance claim will fail.

Educational objective: Private nuisance is a substantial and unreasonable interference with the plaintiff's use and enjoyment of his/her property. An interference is not substantial if the plaintiff's unusual sensitivity causes him/her to find it offensive, annoying, or intolerable when a normal person in the community would not.

选项正确率统计：A选项 77%（正确选项），B选项 2%，C选项 0%，D选项 19%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

私人妨害（Private nuisance）与公共妨害（Public nuisance）


（由私人原告提起的诉讼）干涉不合理性损害
公共公共权利 - 例如，健康、安全、安宁、财产干涉是重大的或违反了法律特殊损害 - 不同于广大公众所受的损害
私人对财产的使用和享用损害的严重性超过了干涉行为的功用实质性干涉 - 对普通人而言是冒犯性的、恼人的或不可容忍的
当原告是公共实体或政府行为人时，不要求损害证明。

妨害（Nuisance）可以是公共的（干涉了公众共有的权利），也可以是私人的（干涉了私人财产权——如此案所示）。当被告对原告使用和享用其财产的侵权干涉同时满足以下两点时，即构成私人妨害责任：

  • 实质性的 - 对社区中的普通人而言是冒犯性的、恼人的或不可容忍的，并且
  • 不合理的 - 原告所受损害的严重性超过了被告行为的功用。


如果原告有异常的敏感性，导致其认为某干涉是冒犯性的、恼人的或不可容忍的，而社区中的普通人却不会这样认为，那么这种干涉就不是实质性的。

在本案中，该制造厂通过发出噪音，使房主在白天无法入睡，从而干涉了房主对其财产的使用和享用（选项D）。但由于该房主上夜班，他对社区其他居民没有注意到的噪音异常敏感。因此，该干涉并非实质性的，该房主不具有可行的妨害诉讼请求。

（选项B）尽管该工厂仅在白天运营，但如果该噪音对社区中的普通人来说是冒犯性的、恼人的或不可容忍的（例如，其他居民也认为该噪音在白天过响），房主仍然可以获得赔偿。

（选项C）在工厂边界之外可以听到噪音——但只有房主能听到。由于房主因该噪音而受到干扰，而其他居民均未注意到（即，他异常敏感），他的妨害诉讼将会失败。

教学目标：私人妨害是对原告使用和享用其财产的实质性且不合理的干涉。如果原告的异常敏感性导致其认为某干涉是冒犯性的、恼人的或不可容忍的，而社区中的普通人却不会这样认为，那么这种干涉就不是实质性的。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 821D (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (private nuisance).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 821F (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (significant harm requirement).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 822 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (liability for nuisance).

MBE 考点解析

侵权法：私人妨害 (Private Nuisance)
核心考点：异常敏感的原告 在私人妨害案件中，判断干扰是否构成“实质性干扰”时，采用的是客观标准，而非主观标准。
法律规则 (The Rule)

私人妨害 (Private Nuisance) 的构成要件要求被告的行为对原告使用和享用土地造成了：

  • 实质性的 (Substantial) 且
  • 不合理的 (Unreasonable) 干扰。

关键测试 (The Test)：干扰必须是对社区中的普通人 (Average Person) 而言是冒犯的、恼人的或无法忍受的。

如果原告因为自身的异常敏感性 (Hypersensitivity) 或土地的特殊用途而感到受干扰，而普通人不会受到影响，则不构成妨害。

本题案情分析
1
客观事实：工厂发出的噪音是“微弱的” (faint)，且该区域的其他居民“并未注意到此噪音”。
2
原告情况：原告之所以无法入睡，是因为他上“夜班” (night shift)，需要在白天睡觉。这属于特殊的生活作息。
3
结论：原告对白天噪音的反应属于异常敏感 (Unusually Sensitive)。既然普通邻居没有受到干扰，那么该噪音在法律上不构成“实质性干扰”。
为什么选 A 而不选 D？

选项 A (正确)：直接指出了法律抗辩理由——原告的异常敏感性导致其索赔失败。

选项 D (错误陷阱)：虽然工厂确实“妨碍”了该特定房主的安宁，但这只是主观后果。MBE 题目常设此类陷阱：描述了事实上的干扰，但忽略了法律上的“客观标准”要件。

MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在做 Nuisance 题目时，如果看到以下关键词，请立即警惕“异常敏感性”考点：

  • "Dog whistle" (只有狗能听到的声音)
  • "Mink farm" (对噪音极度敏感的水貂)
  • "Night shift worker" (夜班工人)
  • "Other residents did not notice" (其他居民未察觉)

记住：Nuisance 保护的是普通人的感受，而不是特立独行者的感受。

Reference: Restatement (Second) of Torts § 821F

questions.question:
An elderly man has resided in a particular neighborhood throughout his life. As has always been his habit, the man brings stale bread to a nearby public park each day to feed the pigeons. There is no state law or local ordinance prohibiting him from doing so. However, in addition to the pigeon droppings and feathers generated by his actions, the food attracts rats.
Several mothers who recently started frequenting the park with their children have brought a private nuisance action against the man to enjoin him from feeding the pigeons. The mothers contend that the man's actions have created an unsafe environment for themselves and their children, interfered with their enjoyment of the park, and defaced park property.
Which of the following is the man's best defense to this action?

choices.a: The man's habit of feeding the pigeons predates the mothers' use of the park.
choices.b: The mothers do not have a possessory interest in the park.
choices.c: The mothers have not alleged an injury different in kind from the general public.
choices.d: There is no state law or local ordinance that prohibits feeding pigeons in public parks.

data.questionStem:
Q83170

An elderly man has resided in a particular neighborhood throughout his life. As has always been his habit, the man brings stale bread to a nearby public park each day to feed the pigeons. There is no state law or local ordinance prohibiting him from doing so. However, in addition to the pigeon droppings and feathers generated by his actions, the food attracts rats.

Several mothers who recently started frequenting the park with their children have brought a private nuisance action against the man to enjoin him from feeding the pigeons. The mothers contend that the man's actions have created an unsafe environment for themselves and their children, interfered with their enjoyment of the park, and defaced park property.

Which of the following is the man's best defense to this action?

一位老人在一个特定的社区居住了一辈子。按照他一贯的习惯，这位老人每天都会带不新鲜的面包到附近的公园喂鸽子。没有任何州法律或地方法规禁止他这样做。然而，除了他的行为产生的鸽子粪便和羽毛外，这些食物还吸引了老鼠。

几位最近开始带孩子频繁光顾该公园的母亲对这位老人提起了私人妨害之诉（private nuisance action），要求禁止他喂鸽子。这些母亲主张，老人的行为为她们自己和她们的孩子创造了一个不安全的环境，妨碍了她们对公园的享用，并污损了公园的财产。

以下哪项是老人对此诉讼的最佳抗辩理由？
options:
A. The man's habit of feeding the pigeons predates the mothers' use of the park.
老人喂鸽子的习惯早于这些母亲使用公园的时间。

B. The mothers do not have a possessory interest in the park.
这些母亲对公园不具有占有权益（possessory interest）。

C. The mothers have not alleged an injury different in kind from the general public.
这些母亲并未主张其遭受的损害与公众所受的损害在种类上有所不同。

D. There is no state law or local ordinance that prohibits feeding pigeons in public parks.
没有州法律或地方法规禁止在公园喂鸽子。
data.explanation:
Private nuisance v. Public nuisance


(action brought by private plaintiff)InterferenceUnreasonableHarm
PublicPublic right - eg, health, safety, peace, propertyInterference is significant or violated lawSpecial harm - harm different from that of public at large
PrivateUse & enjoyment of propertySeverity of harm outweighs utility of interferenceSubstantial interference - offensive, annoying, or intolerable to normal person
Proof of harm not required when plaintiff is public entity or government actor.

A private nuisance is a thing or activity that substantially and unreasonably interferes with another individual's use or enjoyment of real property. To have standing to sue for private nuisance, the plaintiff must have some possessory interest in that property (eg, ownership, lease).

Here, the mothers do not have a possessory interest in a public park. Since the mothers have not alleged harm to their own real property interests - eg, that rats attracted to the park are invading their homes - they lack standing to bring a private nuisance action against the man. Therefore, that is the man's best defense.

(Choice A) A plaintiff "comes to the nuisance" by purchasing (not merely using) property near the defendant's premises, knowing of the nuisance operated by the defendant. This is one factor that the trier of fact may consider in deciding whether the plaintiff can recover for the nuisance, but it is not an automatic defense.

(Choice C) Private citizens (eg, the mothers) have a claim for public nuisance only if they suffer a different kind of injury than the general public. But this limitation does not apply to private nuisance actions.

(Choice D) The defendant's compliance with a statute, ordinance, or administrative regulation may be admitted in a nuisance action as evidence that the defendant's actions were reasonable. But it is not a complete defense.

Educational objective: A person with a possessory interest in real property (eg, ownership, lease) may bring a private nuisance action if the defendant substantially and unreasonably interfered with the person's use and enjoyment of that property.

选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 64%（正确选项），C选项 30%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

私人妨害（Private nuisance）与公共妨害（Public nuisance）之比较


（由私人原告提起的诉讼）妨害（Interference）不合理性（Unreasonable）损害（Harm）
公共妨害公共权利 - 例如，健康、安全、安宁、财产妨害是重大的或违反了法律特殊损害 - 与广大公众所受损害不同的损害
私人妨害对财产的使用与享用损害的严重性超过了妨害行为的功用实质性妨害 - 对正常人而言具有攻击性、令人烦扰或无法忍受
当原告是公共实体或政府行为人时，无需证明损害。

私人妨害是指某一事物或活动实质性且不合理地妨害了他人对不动产的使用或享用。要有提起私人妨害诉讼的诉讼资格（standing），原告必须对该财产拥有某种占有权益（possessory interest）（例如，所有权、租赁权）。

在本案中，这些母亲对一个公共公园不具有占有权益。由于这些母亲并未主张其自身的不动产权益受到损害——例如，被公园吸引的老鼠正在侵入她们的住宅——她们缺乏对该老人提起私人妨害之诉的诉讼资格。因此，这是老人最佳的抗辩理由。

(选项A) 当原告在明知被告经营活动构成妨害的情况下，购买（不仅仅是使用）被告经营场所附近的财产，即构成“自寻妨害”（comes to the nuisance）。这是事实审理者在决定原告是否能就妨害获得赔偿时可能考虑的一个因素，但这并非一个自动成立的抗辩理由。

(选项C) 私人公民（例如，这些母亲）仅在遭受与公众不同种类的损害时，才能就公共妨害提出诉求。但这一限制不适用于私人妨害之诉。

(选项D) 在妨害诉讼中，被告遵守法规、法令或行政规章的行为可被采纳为证明其行为合理的证据。但这并非一个完全的抗辩理由。

教学目标： 在不动产中拥有占有权益（例如，所有权、租赁权）的人，如果被告实质性且不合理地妨害了其对该财产的使用和享用，可以提起私人妨害之诉。

References

Restatement (Second) of Torts §§ 821D, 821E (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (recovery for private nuisance).

MBE 考点解析

Torts: Nuisance (侵权法：妨害)
⚖️ 核心法则 (Black Letter Law)

私人妨害 (Private Nuisance) 是对他人使用和享用土地的实质性且不合理的干扰。

关键在于：原告必须对受影响的土地拥有占有权益 (Possessory Interest)，例如所有权 (Ownership) 或租赁权 (Leasehold)。

✅ 正确答案：选项 B

B 这些母亲对公园不具有占有权益。

The mothers do not have a possessory interest in the park.

深度解析：

本题的解题关键在于识别原告提起的诉讼类型——私人妨害 (Private Nuisance)。

  • 私人妨害旨在保护土地占有人对土地的使用和享用权。
  • 原告（母亲们）只是公园的访客，她们并不拥有公园，也没有租用公园。
  • 因为她们对公园没有占有权益 (Possessory Interest)，所以她们根本没有资格（Lack Standing）提起私人妨害诉讼。
  • 这就是被告（老人）最好的抗辩：从程序上直接否定原告的起诉资格。

🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 C (陷阱)： 关于“特殊损害” (Different in kind)。

这是一个经典的混淆项。如果原告提起的是公共妨害 (Public Nuisance) 之诉，私人原告确实需要证明自己受到的伤害与公众不同（Special Injury）。但本题明确指出原告提起的是私人妨害，因此主要障碍是缺乏土地权益，而不是伤害的种类。

选项 A： 关于“自寻妨害” (Coming to the nuisance)。

这通常指原告搬到了已经存在的妨害源旁边。这只是法院考虑的一个因素，而不是绝对的抗辩理由 (Not a complete defense)。

📊 考点对比：Private vs. Public Nuisance

特征 私人妨害 (Private) 公共妨害 (Public)
保护利益 个人对土地的使用/享用 公众的健康、安全、福利
原告资格 必须有土地占有权益 通常由政府提起；私人提起需证明特殊损害
💡 MBE 考试技巧

看到 "Nuisance"（妨害）题目时，第一步先判断是 Private 还是 Public。

如果是 Private Nuisance，立即检查原告是否拥有土地权益（Owner/Tenant）。如果是访客、雇员或路人，他们通常没有资格提起私人妨害诉讼。

questions.question:
A newspaper published an editorial in which an editor asserted that a candidate for high political office was a user of illegal drugs. The accusation was untrue. The editor acted unreasonably in not investigating the accusation before publishing it; however, the editor honestly believed that the accusation was true.
The candidate sued the editor for defamation.
Is the candidate entitled to recover?

choices.a: No, because the accusation appeared in an editorial and was therefore merely an opinion.
choices.b: No, because the editor honestly believed that the accusation was true.
choices.c: Yes, because calling someone an illegal drug user is defamatory per se.
choices.d: Yes, because the accusation was false and injurious to the candidate's reputation.

data.questionStem:
Q83202

A newspaper published an editorial in which an editor asserted that a candidate for high political office was a user of illegal drugs. The accusation was untrue. The editor acted unreasonably in not investigating the accusation before publishing it; however, the editor honestly believed that the accusation was true.

The candidate sued the editor for defamation.

Is the candidate entitled to recover?

一家报纸发表了一篇社论，其中一位编辑断言，一位高级政治职位的候选人是非法药物使用者。该指控不属实。该编辑在发表前未对指控进行调查，其行为不合理；然而，该编辑真诚地相信该指控是真实的。

该候选人以诽谤为由起诉了该编辑。

该候选人是否有权获得赔偿？
options:
A. No, because the accusation appeared in an editorial and was therefore merely an opinion.
不可以，因为该指控出现在社论中，因此仅仅是一种意见。

B. No, because the editor honestly believed that the accusation was true.
不可以，因为该编辑真诚地相信该指控是真实的。

C. Yes, because calling someone an illegal drug user is defamatory per se.
可以，因为称某人为非法药物使用者构成本身即是诽谤 (defamatory per se)。

D. Yes, because the accusation was false and injurious to the candidate's reputation.
可以，因为该指控是虚假的，并且损害了候选人的声誉。
data.explanation:
Defamation can be either slander (spoken statements) OR libel (written statements - as seen here). A defamation claim based on libel ordinarily requires proof that:
  • the defendant knowingly made a false statement about the plaintiff or negligently failed to determine its falsity
  • that type of statement would tend to harm the plaintiff's reputation and
  • the defendant intentionally or negligently communicated that statement to a third party.


But when the plaintiff is a public figure or official (eg, celebrity, governor), he/she must prove that the false statement was made with actual malice. Actual malice exists when the defendant knew that the statement was false or recklessly disregarded its falsity (ie, had serious doubts about its truthfulness). Therefore, proof of negligence - failure to use reasonable care to determine a statement's falsity - is not enough.

Here, the editor falsely accused the candidate of using illegal drugs in a published editorial. Since the candidate is a public figure, he can only recover for defamation if the editor acted with actual malice. And since the editor honestly believed that the accusation was true (no actual malice), the candidate cannot recover for defamation.

(Choice A) Defamation can stem from a statement alleging a fact or an opinion that appears to be based on specific facts. Here, the editorial asserted that the candidate used illegal drugs (factual allegation). But a stated belief about the candidate's drug use (opinion) would still be actionable if it implied knowledge of specific facts.

(Choice C) Statements that are presumptively harmful to the plaintiff's reputation are considered defamatory per se. Though accusing someone of a criminal act (illegal drug use) is defamatory per se, the candidate will not prevail because the editor believed that the accusation was true (no actual malice).

(Choice D) Although the editor's accusation was false and likely injurious to the candidate's reputation, the candidate will not prevail because the editor did not act with actual malice.

Educational objective: A public figure or public official can only recover for defamation if he/she proves that the defendant made a false statement with actual malice - ie, with knowledge or reckless disregard of the statement's falsity.



选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 68%（正确选项），C选项 9%，D选项 20%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

诽谤 (Defamation) 可以是口头诽谤 (slander)（口头陈述）或书面诽谤 (libel)（书面陈述——如此处所示）。基于书面诽谤的诽谤诉讼通常要求证明：
  • 被告明知有关原告的陈述是虚假的，或因过失未能确定其虚假性
  • 该类陈述会损害原告的声誉并且
  • 被告故意或因过失将该陈述传播给了第三方。


但是，当原告是公众人物或官员（例如，名人、州长）时，他/她必须证明虚假陈述是基于实际恶意 (actual malice) 作出的。当被告知道陈述是虚假的，或鲁莽地漠视其虚假性（即，对其真实性有严重怀疑）时，即存在实际恶意。因此，仅仅证明过失——即未能尽到合理注意来确定陈述的虚假性——是不够的。

在本案中，该编辑在一篇已发表的社论中虚假地指控候选人使用非法药物。由于该候选人是公众人物，只有当编辑的行为具有实际恶意时，他才能因诽谤获得赔偿。而由于该编辑真诚地相信该指控是真实的（不存在实际恶意），因此该候选人不能因诽谤获得赔偿。

(选项A) 诽谤可以源于指控事实的陈述，或者源于看似基于特定事实的意见。在本案中，社论断言候选人使用非法药物（事实指控）。但是，如果关于候选人使用药物的既定看法（意见）暗示了对特定事实的了解，那么它仍然是可诉的。

(选项C) 对原告声誉构成推定损害的陈述被认为是本身即是诽谤 (defamatory per se)。尽管指控他人犯罪行为（使用非法药物）构成本身即是诽谤，但候选人不会胜诉，因为编辑相信该指控是真实的（不存在实际恶意）。

(选项D) 尽管编辑的指控是虚假的，并可能损害了候选人的声誉，但候选人不会胜诉，因为编辑的行为不具有实际恶意。

教学目标： 公众人物或公职人员只有在证明被告作出虚假陈述时怀有实际恶意——即明知其虚假或鲁莽地漠视其虚假性——的情况下，才能因诽谤获得赔偿。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 558 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (elements of defamation).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 568 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (libel and slander distinguished).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 580A (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (defamation of public official or public figure).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

侵权法 (Torts) - 诽谤与宪法标准
核心考点：实际恶意 (Actual Malice)

根据美国最高法院在 New York Times Co. v. Sullivan (1964) 案中的裁决，当原告是公职人员 (Public Official) 或公众人物 (Public Figure) 时，仅仅证明被告有“过失 (Negligence)”是不够的。

原告必须以“清晰且令人信服的证据 (Clear and convincing evidence)”证明被告在发表声明时怀有实际恶意 (Actual Malice)。

逻辑推演
1
确定原告身份：
题目中原告是“高级政治职位的候选人 (Candidate for high political office)”。在诽谤法中，这属于典型的公职人员/公众人物范畴。
2
确定过错标准：
因为原告是公众人物，所以必须证明被告有实际恶意 (Actual Malice)。

注：如果是普通人 (Private Figure) 涉及公共利益事项，通常只需证明过失 (Negligence)。
3
定义实际恶意：
实际恶意包含两种情况：
  • 明知陈述是虚假的 (Knowledge that it was false)；或者
  • 鲁莽地漠视真相 (Reckless disregard for the truth)。
4
应用到本案事实：
题目明确指出编辑的行为是“不合理的 (unreasonably)”（即构成了过失），但是编辑“真诚地相信指控是真实的 (honestly believed that the accusation was true)”。

结论： “真诚相信”直接否定了“明知虚假”和“鲁莽漠视”。虽然编辑有过失，但没有达到宪法要求的“实际恶意”标准。
正确答案 B 的依据 因为编辑真诚地相信指控是真实的，所以他没有实际恶意。对于公众人物原告，没有实际恶意就无法胜诉，即使被告的行为是不合理的（过失）。
🚫 选项 A (Opinion) 错误：
虽然社论通常包含意见，但指控某人“吸毒”是对具体事实的断言 (Factual Assertion)。如果意见暗示了未披露的诽谤性事实，它仍然是可诉的。
🚫 选项 C (Defamation Per Se) 错误：
指控犯罪确实属于“本身即诽谤 (Defamation Per Se)”，这有助于证明损害 (Damages)，但它不能替代对过错 (Fault) 的要求。宪法层面的过错要求（实际恶意）必须先被满足。
🚫 选项 D (False/Injurious) 错误：
虚假和损害是诽谤的要素，但对于公众人物，缺一不可的是“实际恶意”。仅有虚假和损害不足以让公众人物胜诉。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 在做诽谤题时，第一步永远是确认原告的身份：
  • 如果是公众人物/官员 ➡️ 必须找 Actual Malice (知假或鲁莽)。
  • 如果是普通人 ➡️ 通常只需找 Negligence (过失)。
题目中出现 "honestly believed" (真诚相信) 几乎总是用来否定 Actual Malice 的，这是这类题目的经典“解题钥匙”。

questions.question:
A homeowner owns a house on a lake. A neighbor owns a house across a driveway from the homeowner's property. The neighbor's house sits on a hill, and the neighbor can see the lake from his living room window. The homeowner and the neighbor got into an argument, and the homeowner erected a large spotlight on his property that automatically comes on at dusk and goes off at sunrise. The only reason the homeowner installed the light was to annoy the neighbor. The glare from the light severely detracts from the neighbor's view of the lake.
In a suit by the neighbor against the homeowner, will the neighbor prevail?

choices.a: No, because the neighbor's view of the lake is not always obstructed.
choices.b: No, if the spotlight provides added security to the homeowner's property.
choices.c: Yes, because the homeowner installed the light solely to annoy the neighbor.
choices.d: Yes, if, and only if, the neighbor's property value is adversely affected.
